repos.summary_en: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your own devices across any OS and platform. It integrates with messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack, supports voice interaction, live canvas rendering, and prioritizes local deployment for privacy, speed, and always-on personal assistance.

repos.summary_en: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，用于将各类文件（如 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML 等）转换为结构化的 Markdown 格式，专为 LLM 和文本分析流水线设计。它支持 OCR、语音转文本、ZIP 内文件遍历及 YouTube 链接解析，注重保留文档结构（标题、表格、列表等），输出高度兼容主流大模型。
repos.summary_en: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts various file types (PDF, Office docs, images, audio, HTML, etc.) into structured Markdown for use with LLMs and text analysis pipelines. It supports OCR, speech-to-text, ZIP extraction, and YouTube URL conversion, preserving document structure like headings and tables for optimal LLM compatibility.

repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: 为GPT/GLM等LLM大语言模型提供实用化交互接口，特别优化论文阅读/润色/写作体验，模块化设计，支持自定义快捷按钮&函数插件，支持Python和C++等项目剖析&自译解功能，PDF/LaTex论文翻译&总结功能，支持并行问询多种LLM模型，支持chatglm3等本地模型。接入通义千问, deepseekcoder, 讯飞星火, 文心一言, llama2, rwkv, claude2, moss等。
repos.summary_zh: GPT Academic 是为 GPT/GLM 等 LLM 大语言模型设计的实用化交互接口，专注论文阅读、润色与写作优化，支持模块化插件与自定义快捷按钮，集成 Python/C++ 项目剖析、PDF/LaTeX 论文翻译与总结功能，兼容通义千问、DeepSeek、文心一言等主流模型，支持本地部署与多模型并行调用。
repos.summary_en: GPT Academic is a practical interface for GPT/GLM and other LLMs, optimized for academic tasks like paper reading, editing, and writing. It features modular plugins, custom shortcuts, code analysis, PDF/LaTeX translation, and supports multiple models including Qwen, DeepSeek, and local deployments like ChatGLM3.

repos.description: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
repos.summary_zh: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

repos.description: Autonomous coding agent right in your IDE, capable of creating/editing files, executing commands, using the browser, and more with your permission every step of the way.
repos.summary_zh: Cline 是一款集成在 IDE 中的自主编码代理，基于 Claude Sonnet 的代理能力，支持文件创建/编辑、终端命令执行、浏览器操作等，全程需用户授权。通过 AST 分析、正则搜索和上下文管理，可处理复杂开发任务，支持 MCP 扩展工具，提供安全的 AI 编程辅助。
repos.summary_en: Cline is an autonomous coding agent integrated directly into your IDE, powered by Claude Sonnet's agentic capabilities. It can create/edit files, execute terminal commands, use browsers, and more—with your permission at every step. Designed for complex software development tasks through AST analysis, regex searches, and context-aware workflows, it extends functionality via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while maintaining human oversight for safety.

repos.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.

repos.summary_en: CLI-Anything enables any software to become agent-native, bridging AI agents with real-world tools via standardized interfaces. Features one-command installation from the community-driven CLI-Hub, compatibility with platforms like Cursor and Claude Code, support for 16+ applications, and 100% test pass rate (1,839 tests). Includes automated registry updates, meta-skill discovery, and dual JSON/human-readable output formats.

repos.description: Get your documents ready for gen AI
repos.summary_zh: Docling 是一个强大的文档处理工具，支持多种格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX等）的解析与理解，具备高级 PDF 布局分析、表格识别、OCR 及音频转文本功能。它提供统一的 DoclingDocument 输出格式，支持导出为 Markdown、HTML、JSON 等格式，并无缝集成 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等 AI 框架，专为生成式 AI 应用打造。
repos.summary_en: Docling is a powerful document processing tool that parses diverse formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, etc.) with advanced PDF layout analysis, table recognition, OCR, and ASR capabilities. It outputs unified DoclingDocument format, supports exports to Markdown, HTML, JSON, and integrates seamlessly with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and other AI frameworks for gen AI applications.

repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: Flowise 是一个可视化 AI 智能体构建平台，支持通过拖拽方式快速搭建 LLM 应用流程。它提供图形化界面集成主流大模型、向量数据库和工具节点，支持本地部署与云端服务，适用于开发者和企业快速原型开发与生产部署。
repos.summary_en: Flowise is a visual platform for building AI agents and LLM applications using drag-and-drop workflows. It integrates major LLMs, vector databases, and tools via a no-code interface, supporting both self-hosted and cloud deployment for rapid prototyping and production use.

repos.summary_zh: MindsDB 是一个开源 AI 分析查询引擎，支持构建能直接访问数据库、数据仓库和应用程序的自主推理 AI 代理。它通过 SQL 兼容语言统一 200+ 数据源，无需 ETL，实现自然语言问答和语义搜索，适用于对话式分析、知识库检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: MindsDB is an open-source AI analytics query engine that powers self-reasoning agents to answer questions directly from live data sources like databases and data warehouses without ETL. It unifies 200+ data sources via SQL-compatible syntax, enabling conversational analytics and semantic search across structured and unstructured data.

repos.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
repos.summary_zh: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 技能蒸馏工具，通过分析公开资料提取顶尖人物的认知框架、决策启发式和表达模式，让用户直接调用乔布斯、马斯克等名人的思维方式解决实际问题。核心功能包括五层心智模型提取（表达DNA、认知框架、决策启发式、反模式、诚实边界），支持一键安装并已在 Claude Code 中验证可用性。
repos.summary_en: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent that distills the cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication patterns of top-tier individuals like Jobs, Musk, and Zhang Xuefeng from public data. It enables users to invoke these distilled mental models directly in Claude Code for problem-solving. The system extracts five layers of thinking patterns (expression DNA, cognitive architecture, judgment heuristics, anti-patterns, and honest boundaries) with clear limitations on what cannot be captured.

repos.description: LLM API 管理 & 分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、字节豆包、ChatGLM、文心一言、讯飞星火、通义千问、360 智脑、腾讯混元等主流模型，统一 API 适配，可用于 key 管理与二次分发。单可执行文件，提供 Docker 镜像，一键部署，开箱即用。LLM API management & key redistribution system, unifying multiple providers under a single API. Single binary, Docker-ready, with an English UI.
repos.summary_zh: One API 是一个统一的 LLM API 管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、文心一言等数十家主流大模型，通过标准 OpenAI API 格式统一接入，实现密钥管理、负载均衡与二次分发。提供单可执行文件部署、Docker 镜像及英文 Web UI，开箱即用，适用于企业级多模型集成场景。
repos.summary_en: One API is a unified LLM API management and distribution system that supports over 20 mainstream models including OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Baidu's Wenxin. It standardizes access via OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling key management, load balancing, and redistribution. Deployable as a single binary or Docker image with an English web interface, it offers out-of-the-box functionality for enterprise multi-model integration.

repos.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh
repos.summary_zh: zsh-autosuggestions 为 zsh 终端提供类 Fish 的实时命令建议功能，基于历史记录和补全引擎智能生成建议。支持自定义高亮样式与建议策略，可无缝集成 Oh My Zsh，显著提升命令行输入效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: zsh-autosuggestions delivers Fish-like real-time command suggestions for zsh, leveraging history and completion engines. Features customizable highlighting and multiple suggestion strategies, integrates seamlessly with Oh My Zsh to boost terminal productivity.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 ShadowsocksX 的下一代 macOS 客户端，采用 Swift 重写 GUI 并集成 shadowsocks-libev 的 ss-local 组件。支持 SIP003 插件、AEAD 加密、PAC 自动更新及二维码分享服务器配置，提供手动代理模式以兼容其他应用。通过 launchd 后台运行 ss-local，提升稳定性并简化依赖管理。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, rebuilt with Swift and integrated with ss-local from shadowsocks-libev. It supports SIP003 plugins, AEAD ciphers, PAC auto-updates, QR code sharing, and manual proxy mode. By running ss-local as a background service via launchd, it improves stability and simplifies dependency management.

repos.description: The most advanced responsive front-end framework in the world. Quickly create prototypes and production code for sites that work on any kind of device.
repos.summary_zh: Foundation 是全球最先进的响应式前端框架，支持快速从原型开发到生产环境部署。提供完全可定制的响应式网格系统、丰富的 Sass 混合宏、常用 JavaScript 插件及完整的无障碍访问支持，适用于构建跨设备兼容的网站和应用程序。
repos.summary_en: Foundation is the most advanced responsive front-end framework globally, enabling rapid prototyping and production-ready development of sites and apps that work seamlessly across all devices. It features a fully customizable responsive grid, extensive Sass mixins, essential JavaScript plugins, and comprehensive accessibility support.

repos.description: 410 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (120+ Agents, custom commands, 410+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
repos.summary_zh: Claude Skills & Plugins 是开源的 AI 编码工具增强库，提供205个生产级技能包，覆盖工程、产品、营销、合规及高管咨询等领域。支持11种主流AI开发工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI），所有Python工具均为stdlib-only，无需额外依赖。通过模块化指令包和CLI脚本实现跨领域专家能力扩展。
repos.summary_en: Claude Skills & Plugins is an open-source library offering 205 production-ready agent skills for 11 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It provides reusable domain expertise in engineering, marketing, compliance, and C-level advisory via modular instruction packages and zero-pip Python tools. All components are cross-platform and tool-agnostic.

repos.description: 🌩 Self-hosted file management and sharing system, supports multiple storage providers
repos.summary_zh: Cloudreve 是一个自托管文件管理与共享系统，支持对接本地、OneDrive、S3、七牛云、阿里云OSS等十余种存储后端。提供 WebDAV、在线预览、拖拽上传、批量下载、多用户权限管理等功能，开箱即用，适合企业或个人私有云部署。
repos.summary_en: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system supporting multiple storage backends like Local, OneDrive, S3, Qiniu, Aliyun OSS, etc. It offers features such as WebDAV, online preview, drag-and-drop upload, batch download, multi-user/group access control, and is ready-to-use for private cloud deployment.

repos.summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

repos.description: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.
repos.summary_zh: mihomo 是一个专为《崩坏：星穹铁道》设计的 Python Pydantic 数据模型库，提供对 Mihomo API 解析数据的强类型支持与自动补全。支持 V1/V2 两种数据格式，内置工具函数处理角色去重与数据合并，并提供 JSON 和 Pickle 持久化方案，显著提升游戏数据集成开发效率。
repos.summary_en: mihomo is a Python Pydantic model library designed for Honkai: Star Rail, offering strongly-typed data structures and autocompletion support for parsed data from the Mihomo API. It supports both V1 and V2 data formats, includes utility functions for character deduplication and data merging, and provides JSON/Pickle persistence options, greatly enhancing game data integration workflows.

It offers a customizable Material Design theme ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: Patched fonts for Powerline users.
repos.summary_zh: Powerline 字体仓库提供专为 Powerline 状态栏插件优化的预配置字体，支持多种流行编程字体（如 Hack、Fira Mono、Meslo 等），涵盖 BSD、Apache、SIL 等开源许可证，适用于 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 终端环境，提升终端显示美观性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides pre-patched fonts optimized for the Powerline statusline plugin, featuring popular programming fonts like Hack, Fira Mono, and Meslo under open licenses such as BSD, Apache, and SIL. It supports quick installation via script or package manager across Linux, macOS, and Windows terminals, enhancing visual appeal and readability.

repos.description: 基于 ChatGPT API 的划词翻译浏览器插件和跨平台桌面端应用    -    Browser extension and cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 ChatGPT API 的智能划词翻译工具，支持浏览器插件和跨平台桌面应用。提供翻译、润色、摘要三大功能，覆盖55种语言互译，支持流式响应、文本朗读、截图翻译及多LLM平台接入（OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax），具备词汇本管理和记忆辅助生成能力。
repos.summary_en: An intelligent word-selection translator powered by ChatGPT API, available as both a browser extension and cross-platform desktop app. Offers translation, polishing, and summarization across 55 languages, with streaming support, TTS, screenshot translation, vocabulary books, and multi-LLM provider integration (OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax).

repos.description: 将冰冷的离别化为温暖的 Skill，欢迎加入数字生命1.0！Transforming cold farewells into warm skills? It's giving rebirth era. Welcome to Digital Life 1.0. 🫶
repos.summary_zh: 同事.skill 是一款基于 AgentSkills 标准的 AI 智能体工具，通过分析飞书、钉钉、邮件等数据源，生成具备真实工作能力和人物性格的 AI Skill。它能模拟离职同事的技术规范、代码风格与沟通方式，实现知识传承与数字永生，适用于企业知识管理、新人培训和协作连续性维护。
repos.summary_en: Colleague.skill is an AI agent tool built on the AgentSkills standard that generates realistic AI skills by analyzing data sources like Feishu, DingTalk, and emails. It simulates a departed colleague's technical expertise, coding style, and communication patterns to enable knowledge transfer and digital continuity in workplaces.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

repos.description: A plugin for Mac WeChat
repos.summary_zh: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac 是一款专为 macOS 设计的微信插件，支持多开、免认证登录、消息撤回同步、自定义回复及AI自动回复等功能。集成迷离/黑夜/上帝/少女等主题皮肤，适配微信3.1.2+，兼容企业微信与简版助手，提供跨平台消息转发与小程序详情展示，是Objective-C生态中广受欢迎的自动化工具之一。
repos.summary_en: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac is a macOS plugin for WeChat that enables multi-account login, message recall sync, custom replies, and AI auto-reply. It supports themes like Mysterious/Dark/God/Daughter modes, integrates with WeChat 3.1.2+, and offers features like message forwarding, mini-program details, and cross-device notifications. A popular Objective-C project with enterprise and lightweight versions.

repos.description: A powerful coding agent toolkit providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities (MCP server & other integrations)
repos.summary_zh: Serena 是一个强大的编码代理工具包，通过语义检索和编辑能力（MCP 服务器等集成）将 LLM 转变为可直接操作代码库的全功能代理。它提供类似 IDE 的符号级代码检索与编辑工具，显著提升大模型在代码理解与修改中的效率与准确性，支持多种 LLM 集成方式，包括 MCP、OpenAPI 及自定义代理框架。
repos.summary_en: Serena is a powerful coding agent toolkit that transforms an LLM into a fully-featured agent capable of directly operating on your codebase. It provides IDE-like semantic code retrieval and editing tools at the symbol level, greatly improving token efficiency and code quality. Serena integrates with LLMs via MCP, OpenAPI, or custom agent frameworks, enabling precise code navigation and modification without full-file reads or string replacements.

repos.summary_en: pjax is a jQuery plugin that combines pushState and ajax to enable fast, seamless page navigation without full reloads. It dynamically loads HTML content, updates the browser URL, and preserves permalinks, titles, and back-button functionality for enhanced user experience.

repos.summary_zh: Claudian 是一款 Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code 嵌入为 AI 协作者，赋予其完整的代理能力：读写文件、搜索、执行 Bash 命令及多步骤工作流。支持上下文感知、Vision 图像分析、内联编辑、指令模式、Slash 命令、技能扩展、自定义 Agent、Claude Code 插件集成、MCP 协议连接外部工具，并提供高级模型控制与安全权限管理，显著提升知识管理与自动化效率。
repos.summary_en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI collaborator within your vault, providing full agentic capabilities: file read/write, search, bash commands, and multi-step workflows. It supports context-awareness, Vision image analysis, inline editing, instruction mode, slash commands, skills, custom agents, Claude Code plugins, MCP integration for external tools, advanced model control, and security permissions, enhancing knowledge management and automation.

repos.description: 微信小助手
repos.summary_zh: WeChatPlugin-MacOS 是一款 macOS 平台的微信小助手工具，旨在提升用户工作效率。它通过自动化消息处理、快捷回复、群管理等功能，简化日常沟通流程，支持多账号管理，适用于需要高效处理微信消息的 macOS 用户。
repos.summary_en: WeChatPlugin-MacOS is a macOS assistant tool for WeChat, designed to enhance productivity. It automates message handling, enables quick replies, and supports group management, streamlining daily communication. Ideal for macOS users managing multiple WeChat accounts efficiently.

repos.description: A search tool helps dev to solve the naming things problem.
repos.summary_zh: CODELF 是一个智能变量命名工具，通过搜索 GitHub 等代码托管平台上的真实项目，为开发者提供精准的变量命名建议。支持 VS Code、Atom、Sublime Text 等编辑器插件，并集成每日算法题推荐功能，同时可管理 GitHub 仓库标签与收藏，显著提升代码命名效率与规范性。
repos.summary_en: CODELF is a smart variable naming tool that helps developers find real-world naming patterns by searching across GitHub and other code repositories. It offers IDE plugins for VS Code, Atom, and Sublime Text, features a daily algorithm practice guide, and includes GitHub repository tagging/organization tools to improve code naming consistency and productivity.

repos.description: A collection of 100+ specialized Claude Code subagents covering a wide range of development use cases
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是 Claude Code 子代理的精选集合，包含127+个专业化AI助手，覆盖API设计、前后端开发、DevOps、测试等全开发场景。支持插件市场一键安装、交互式脚本及独立安装器，提供开箱即用的开发自动化工具链。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the definitive collection of 127+ specialized Claude Code subagents for development tasks, covering API design, full-stack development, DevOps, and testing. It offers one-click plugin installation, interactive scripts, and standalone installers for instant developer productivity.

repos.description: A command-line tool for tweaking WeChat - 首款微信 macOS 客户端撤回拦截与多开 🔨
repos.summary_zh: WeChatTweak 是一款专为 macOS 设计的命令行工具，支持微信客户端撤回消息拦截、阻止自动更新及多开功能，通过二进制补丁技术实现原生应用增强，显著提升微信使用灵活性与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: WeChatTweak is a command-line tool for macOS that enables WeChat enhancements including message recall blocking, auto-update prevention, and multi-instance support via binary patching, offering advanced customization for native app workflows.

repos.description: :metal: A collection of Alfred 3 and 4 workflows that will rock your world
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列 Alfred 3/4 工作流工具，涵盖系统休眠控制、浏览器兼容性查询、色彩格式转换、开发文档检索、域名搜索及表情符号查找等实用功能，通过快捷键快速调用，显著提升 macOS 开发者和效率用户的日常操作体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a curated collection of Alfred 3/4 workflows for macOS, including system sleep control, browser compatibility checks, color format conversion, developer documentation search, domain lookup, and emoji search, all accessible via keyboard shortcuts to boost productivity.

repos.description: An extended table for integration with some of the most widely used CSS frameworks. (Supports Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, Material Design, Foundation, Vue.js)
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Table 是一个功能强大的表格扩展插件，支持 Bootstrap、Semantic UI、Bulma、Material Design 等主流 CSS 框架。提供排序、分页、筛选、多选、卡片视图、详情视图等丰富功能，支持 AJAX 数据加载、本地化和扩展机制，适用于数据展示与交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Table is a feature-rich table extension for popular CSS frameworks like Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, and Material Design. It offers sorting, pagination, filtering, row selection, card/detail views, AJAX data loading, localization, and extensibility, making it ideal for dynamic data presentation and interaction.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是 Material Theme 的官方继任者，为 VS Code 提供现代化主题与图标套件，包含六种精心设计的深色主题（如 Teal、Ocean、Carbon），支持高度定制与持续更新，专为开发者打造视觉沉浸的编码环境。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the premium successor to Material Theme for VS Code, offering six hand-curated dark themes and icons with enhanced customization, modern aesthetics, and continuous updates for an immersive developer experience.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server 是一款基于 Chrome 扩展的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，将浏览器功能暴露给 Claude 等 AI 助手，实现复杂浏览器自动化、内容分析与语义搜索。它直接利用用户现有 Chrome 环境，保留登录状态与配置，支持 20+ 工具，提供本地流式 HTTP 通信，并集成 SIMD 加速的向量数据库，实现智能跨标签页语义检索。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex automation, content analysis, and semantic search. It leverages your existing Chrome browser with preserved login states and settings, supports 20+ tools, offers local streamable HTTP communication, and features SIMD-accelerated vector database for intelligent tab content discovery.

repos.description: 🐸 Read Frog - Open-source AI language learning & flashcards, an Immersive Translate alternative | 🐸 陪读蛙 - 开源 AI 语言学习与闪词卡，沉浸式翻译替代
repos.summary_zh: Read Frog 是一款开源浏览器 AI 语言学习扩展，支持沉浸式翻译、文章分析、多 AI 模型适配及字幕翻译。提供双语对照、上下文感知翻译、自定义提示词、批量请求和文本转语音功能，覆盖 Chrome/Edge/Firefox，助力用户高效深度学习。
repos.summary_en: Read Frog is an open-source browser extension for AI-powered language learning, offering immersive translation, article analysis, subtitle translation, and TTS. It supports bilingual mode, context-aware translation, custom prompts, batch requests, and integrates 20+ AI providers across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.

repos.summary_zh: Noi 是一款以交互为核心的工作流工具，主打‘少些混乱，多些流畅’的理念。它提供多窗口管理、会话隔离、本地数据存储、AI提示词管理、内置终端及跨平台 CLI 控制等功能，旨在提升开发者的专注力与效率，适用于需要并行工作空间和高定制化环境的用户。
repos.summary_en: Noi is an interaction-first workflow tool focused on reducing chaos and enhancing productivity. It features multi-window management, session isolation, local data storage, AI prompt management, built-in terminal, and a cross-platform CLI for integration with tools like Claude Code. Designed for developers seeking streamlined, customizable workflows.

repos.description: Community interface for generative AI
repos.summary_zh: StableStudio 是 Stability AI 开源的生成式 AI 社区界面，作为 DreamStudio 的开源版本，提供图像生成与编辑功能。采用插件化架构支持灵活后端集成，用户可通过自定义插件对接任意 AI 服务。项目鼓励社区贡献，支持 TypeScript 扩展，默认使用 Stability API 插件需配置 API 密钥。
repos.summary_en: StableStudio is Stability AI's open-source community interface for generative AI, serving as the open-source variant of DreamStudio. It enables image generation and editing through a web-based UI with a plugin system for flexible backend integration. Users can create custom plugins in TypeScript to connect any AI service, with default Stability API plugin requiring an API key.

repos.description: A simple, open source bilingual translation extension & Greasemonkey script (一个简约、开源的 双语对照翻译扩展 & 油猴脚本)
repos.summary_zh: KISS Translator 是一款简约开源的双语对照翻译工具，支持浏览器扩展与油猴脚本两种形式。它适配主流浏览器，集成 Google、OpenAI、DeepL 等10+翻译服务，覆盖网页翻译、划词翻译、输入框翻译、YouTube字幕翻译等场景，支持自定义规则、术语词典、跨端数据同步及AI上下文记忆，提供高度灵活的翻译体验。
repos.summary_en: KISS Translator is a minimalist, open-source bilingual translation tool available as both a browser extension and a Tampermonkey script. It supports 10+ translation services including Google, OpenAI, and DeepL, covering web page translation, text selection, input field translation, and YouTube subtitle translation. Features include custom rules, term dictionaries, cross-device sync via KISS-Worker, and AI context memory for enhanced translation quality.

repos.description: Stop writing prompts from scratch — a searchable prompt library for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Cursor · Русский 한국어 العربية हिन्दी ไทย ｜ 别再从头写提示词：现成的拿来就用，好用的收进自己的库
repos.summary_zh: AiShort 是一款高效的 AI 提示词管理工具，提供海量精选提示词库，支持一键复制、智能搜索与多语言适配。用户可自定义标签分类、收藏常用提示词，并通过社区分享优质内容。配合浏览器插件实现跨平台的快捷调用，显著提升 AI 交互效率。
repos.summary_en: AiShort is an AI prompt management tool that offers a curated library of prompts for quick access and productivity enhancement. It supports smart search, custom tagging, community sharing, and browser extension integration for seamless use across platforms.

repos.description: 简悦 ( SimpRead ) - 让你瞬间进入沉浸式阅读的扩展
repos.summary_zh: 简悦是一款专为提升中文阅读体验设计的浏览器扩展，通过原创的阅读模式自动提取网页标题、正文、媒体资源等核心内容，适配数百种网站。支持聚焦模式、手动框选、代码高亮、LaTeX/Markdown解析及自定义样式，并集成剪藏、标注、稍后读等功能，是高效的知识管理工具。
repos.summary_en: SimpRead is a browser extension designed to enhance Chinese reading experience by extracting core content (title, body, media) from hundreds of websites via its proprietary reading mode. It supports focus mode, manual selection, code highlighting, LaTeX/Markdown rendering, custom CSS, and integrates clipping, annotation, and read-later features as a productivity tool.

repos.description: Elegant and powerful theme for Hexo.
repos.summary_zh: NexT 是一款优雅且功能强大的 Hexo 主题，专为静态博客设计。支持多风格（Muse、Mist、Pisces、Gemini），集成 PJAX 加速、CDN 配置、第三方插件扩展等高级功能，注重代码高亮、响应式布局与 SEO 优化，适合技术博客与个人站点。
repos.summary_en: NexT is an elegant and powerful theme for Hexo, designed for static blogs. It offers multiple styles (Muse, Mist, Pisces, Gemini), supports advanced features like PJAX navigation, CDN integration, and third-party plugins, with strong emphasis on code highlighting, responsive design, and SEO optimization for tech blogs and personal sites.

repos.description: Use your locally running AI models to assist you in your web browsing
repos.summary_zh: Page Assist 是一款开源浏览器扩展，通过本地运行 AI 模型（如 Ollama）为网页浏览提供智能助手功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，具备侧边栏交互和独立 Web UI 两种使用方式，用户可直接在任意网页中与本地 AI 对话，实现网页内容问答与知识提取。
repos.summary_en: Page Assist is an open-source browser extension that enables interaction with locally running AI models (e.g., via Ollama) directly from any webpage. It offers a sidebar and standalone web UI for Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, allowing users to chat with webpage content using their own AI model.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 桌面版是一款插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。其核心特性包括：通过插件机制接入任意音源（如搜索、播放、歌单导入），高度定制化主题系统（支持 CSS 变量与 iframe 背景），以及本地数据存储保障隐私。用户可自由扩展音源与界面风格，实现个性化音乐体验。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree Desktop is a plugin-based, ad-free, open-source music player supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include: plugin-driven access to any audio source (search, playback, playlist import), highly customizable themes via CSS variables and iframe backgrounds, and local data storage for privacy. Users can extend sources and personalize UI freely.

repos.description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
repos.summary_zh: DroidRun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，通过 LLM 智能体实现自然语言控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。支持多模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic 等），具备复杂任务规划能力，提供 CLI 工具和 Python API，集成截图分析与执行追踪，实现高效移动端自动化。
repos.summary_en: DroidRun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via LLM agents using natural language commands. It supports multiple LLM providers, offers planning capabilities for complex tasks, includes a CLI tool with debugging features, and integrates screenshot analysis and execution tracing for mobile automation.

repos.description: Run agents in Obsidian - OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code etc.
repos.summary_zh: Copilot for Obsidian 是一款专为知识库打造的 AI 助手插件，支持本地与云端大模型接入、智能笔记搜索、多媒体内容理解及自主代理功能。其核心优势在于数据完全由用户掌控，无需依赖第三方服务器，同时提供项目模式、写作辅助和自动化工具调用等高级功能，构建个人专属的 AI 第二大脑。
repos.summary_en: Copilot for Obsidian is an AI assistant plugin designed for knowledge management, integrating local/cloud LLMs, intelligent vault search, multimedia understanding, and autonomous agent capabilities. It emphasizes user data ownership with no provider lock-in, offering advanced features like project mode, writing assistance, and tool automation within Obsidian's customizable workspace.

repos.description: The mobile-friendly, responsive, and lightweight jQuery date & time input picker.
repos.summary_zh: pickadate.js 是一个轻量级、响应式且移动端友好的 jQuery 日期和时间选择器库，支持多种主题和语言翻译，提供灵活的 API 和 LESS 样式定制能力，适用于现代化 Web 表单交互。
repos.summary_en: pickadate.js is a lightweight, responsive, and mobile-friendly jQuery date & time picker library with support for multiple themes, language translations, and customizable LESS-based styling, ideal for modern web form inputs.

repos.description: 洛雪音乐音源、MusicFree音源、落雪音乐音源

repos.summary_en: This project delivers audio source plugins for Lx Music and MusicFree, supporting up to 320k bitrate streaming. It offers CDN-hosted APIs for zero-install usage across mobile and desktop clients, with IP protection guidelines and recovery methods.

repos.summary_en: DroidPlugin is an Android plugin framework enabling the host app to run any third-party APK without installation, modification, or repackaging. It provides complete code and resource isolation, process management, and system API support, requiring only one line of code integration and compatible with Android 2.3+. repos.description: This is a repository for collecting global custom management extensions for the Django Framework.

repos.summary_en: Django Extensions is a collection of custom management extensions for Django, offering tools like model graphing, URL inspection, template validation, shell_plus, and runserver_plus to enhance developer productivity and debugging workflows.

repos.description: Curated list of apps and tools that not only use the new ChatGPT API, but also allow users to configure their own API keys, enabling free and on-demand usage of their own quota.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome ChatGPT API 是一个精心策划的资源列表，汇集了支持用户自定义 API 密钥的应用和工具，实现免费按需调用自有配额。涵盖浏览器插件、Web/桌面应用、CLI 工具及开发资源，适用于多场景 AI 集成，如翻译、搜索摘要、代码辅助等，助力开发者构建高效 ChatGPT 生态。
repos.summary_en: Awesome ChatGPT API is a curated collection of apps and tools that support custom API key configuration, enabling free on-demand usage of personal quotas. It includes browser extensions, web/desktop apps, CLI tools, and development resources, supporting diverse AI integrations like translation, search summarization, and code assistance for building a robust ChatGPT ecosystem.

repos.description: VSCode插件：自动生成，自动更新VSCode文件头部注释, 自动生成函数注释并支持提取函数参数，支持所有主流语言，文档齐全，使用简单，配置灵活方便，持续维护多年。
repos.summary_zh: koroFileHeader 是一款 VSCode 插件，专注于自动生成文件头部注释、自动更新编辑信息，并支持函数注释与参数提取。支持所有主流编程语言，配置灵活，文档详尽，自2018年持续维护，拥有超39.7万用户，日均安装量达200-500次，助力开发者规范代码风格与提升编码效率。
repos.summary_en: koroFileHeader is a VSCode plugin that automates file header comment generation, updates last editor and timestamp, and supports function documentation with automatic parameter extraction. It works across all major programming languages, offers flexible configuration, comprehensive documentation, and has been actively maintained since 2018 with over 397K users and daily installs of 200–500.

repos.description: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
repos.summary_zh: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
repos.summary_en: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

repos.description: A ready-to-go translation ocr tool developed with WPF/WPF 开发的一款即用即走的翻译、OCR工具
repos.summary_zh: STranslate 是一款基于 WPF 开发的即用即走翻译与 OCR 工具，支持多语言实时翻译与屏幕文字识别，具备轻量化、跨平台特性，提供简洁高效的用户界面，适用于办公、学习等场景的文本快速处理需求。
repos.summary_en: STranslate is a ready-to-use translation and OCR tool built with WPF, offering real-time multilingual translation and screen text recognition. It features a lightweight, cross-platform design with an intuitive interface, ideal for quick text processing in work and study environments.

repos.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 插件与皮肤生态：一切皆插件。任务看板、移动端远程与 SSH 运维构筑开发工作台；皮肤经 WebGL 深度优化，更支持 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸；皮肤、宠物、插件由 DSH 大市场一键安装，正迈向 DSH 创意工坊。A pluggable plugin-skin ecosystem for the DSH Web GUI - Task board, remote mobile UI, SSH ops, WebGL-optimized skins with Wallpaper Engine wallpapers - becoming a DSH creative workshop.

repos.description: A jQuery UI theme based on Twitter Bootstrap
repos.summary_zh: jQuery UI Bootstrap 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 设计的 jQuery UI 主题，旨在让 jQuery UI 组件与 Bootstrap 风格无缝融合。它支持与 Bootstrap 共存，并提供现代化外观，同时兼容 jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3 及现代浏览器。项目处于活跃开发中，目标是实现 Bootstrap 3.x 兼容性，欢迎社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: jQuery UI Bootstrap is a theme for jQuery UI widgets inspired by Twitter Bootstrap's design, enabling visual consistency between Bootstrap and jQuery UI components. It supports coexistence with Bootstrap CSS and targets jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3. The project is actively developed with goals to achieve Bootstrap 3.x compatibility and welcomes contributors.

repos.description: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

repos.description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
repos.summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
repos.summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

repos.description: Chrome扩展：支持GPT（Codex） / kiro / Grok自动注册、上传
repos.summary_zh: FlowPilot 是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为批量自动化 ChatGPT OAuth 注册与登录流程设计。支持多邮箱服务（如 QQ、163、DuckDuckGo、Cloudflare 等）获取验证码，具备自动填写表单、密码生成、失败重试、自定义邮箱池及号池管理等功能，适用于 CPA/SUB2API 账号批量运营场景。
repos.summary_en: FlowPilot is a Chrome extension designed for batch automation of ChatGPT OAuth registration and login. It supports multiple email services (e.g., QQ, 163, DuckDuckGo, Cloudflare) to retrieve verification codes, with features like auto-form filling, password generation, retry on failure, custom email pools, and account management—ideal for scaling CPA/SUB2API operations.

repos.description: ReactiveX for Python
repos.summary_zh: RxPY 是一个基于 Python 的 ReactiveX 实现，支持响应式编程范式，提供超过 120 个操作符和 1300+ 单元测试，支持异步事件流处理、可观察序列操作及调度器管理，兼容 Python 3.9+，适用于构建高并发、事件驱动型应用。
repos.summary_en: RxPY is a ReactiveX implementation for Python, enabling reactive programming with over 120 operators and 1300+ unit tests. It supports asynchronous event streams, observable sequences, and schedulers, designed for building concurrent, event-driven applications in Python 3.9+.

repos.description: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

repos.description: cursor IDE enjoy VIP
repos.summary_zh: cursor-vip 是一个通过共享方式解锁 Cursor IDE 付费 VIP 功能的工具，支持多语言配置与代理模式。它提供稳定的 Claude 模型访问，通过脚本或二进制文件快速部署，适用于开发者绕过区域限制使用高级 AI 编程功能，但稳定性不及官方版本。
repos.summary_en: cursor-vip is a tool that unlocks Cursor IDE's paid VIP features via shared access, supporting multi-language configuration and proxy modes. It offers stable Claude model access, easy deployment via scripts or binaries, and enables developers to use advanced AI coding features despite regional payment restrictions, though with lower stability than the official version.

repos.description: Bootstrap components built with Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: VueStrap 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Bootstrap 3 构建的原生组件库，提供无需 jQuery 依赖的轻量级 UI 解决方案。现已停止维护，推荐使用功能更完善的替代方案 BootstrapVue 或 uiv。
repos.summary_en: VueStrap is a native Vue.js component library built on Bootstrap 3, offering jQuery-free UI components. It is no longer maintained; users are advised to migrate to BootstrapVue or uiv for enhanced features and accessibility.

repos.description: A generic system for filtering Django QuerySets based on user selections
repos.summary_zh: Django-filter 是一个用于在 Django 中基于用户选择动态过滤 QuerySet 的通用应用，支持通过 URL 参数生成类似 admin 的筛选界面，提供类似 ModelForms 的声明式 API，并深度集成 Django REST Framework，适用于构建灵活的数据筛选接口。
repos.summary_en: Django-filter is a reusable Django application that enables declarative dynamic QuerySet filtering via URL parameters, offering an API similar to ModelForms. It supports admin-like filtering interfaces and integrates seamlessly with Django REST Framework for building flexible data filtering endpoints.

repos.description: WeChat SDK for Python
repos.summary_zh: WeChatpy 是一个功能完整的微信公众平台第三方 Python SDK，支持普通公众平台被动响应、企业微信、微信支付、第三方平台代调用及小程序云开发等核心 API 集成，提供简洁易用的接口封装，适用于快速构建微信生态应用。
repos.summary_en: WeChatpy is a comprehensive third-party Python SDK for the WeChat public platform, supporting core APIs such as passive response, enterprise WeChat, WeChat Pay, third-party proxy calls, and mini-program cloud development, offering a clean interface for rapid integration into WeChat ecosystem applications.

repos.description: A Python implementation of John Gruber’s Markdown with Extension support.
repos.summary_zh: Python-Markdown 是 Python 实现的 John Gruber 官方 Markdown 语法解析器，高度兼容参考实现，支持扩展机制，提供简洁的 API 将 Markdown 文本转换为标准 HTML，广泛用于文档生成、静态站点构建和内容管理系统。
repos.summary_en: Python-Markdown is a Python implementation of John Gruber's Markdown, nearly fully compliant with the reference implementation. It supports extensible syntax via plugins, offering a clean API to convert Markdown text into HTML, widely used in documentation, static site generation, and content management systems.

repos.description: An open-source implementation of uTools, a high-performance, scalable application launcher and plugin platform | Supports macOS and Windows, 一个高性能、可扩展的应用启动器和插件平台  uTools 的开源实现 | 支持 macOS 和 Windows
repos.summary_zh: ZTools 是 uTools 的开源实现，一个高性能跨平台应用启动器与插件平台，支持 macOS 和 Windows。采用 Electron + LMDB 数据库架构，具备拼音搜索、正则匹配、剪贴板管理等核心功能，内置插件市场支持在线安装与热更新，提供主题定制与完整 TypeScript API，适用于快速启动应用与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: ZTools is an open-source implementation of uTools, a high-performance cross-platform application launcher and plugin platform for macOS and Windows. Built with Electron + LMDB database architecture, it features pinyin search, regex matching, clipboard management, and an integrated plugin market with online installation and auto-updates. Offers theme customization, full TypeScript API support, and seamless app launching/automation workflows.

repos.description: A cross-platform and extendable version manager with support for Java, Node.js, Golang, Python, Flutter, .NET & more
repos.summary_zh: vfox 是一款跨平台、可扩展的版本管理器，支持 Java、Node.js、Go、Python、Flutter、.NET 等多种运行时环境。它通过插件系统统一管理多语言开发环境，支持项目级版本隔离、自动切换和主流 shell 集成，简化了多项目环境下的依赖配置复杂度。
repos.summary_en: vfox is a cross-platform, extensible version manager (similar to nvm, asdf-vm) supporting Java, Node.js, Go, Python, Flutter, .NET and more. It enables unified management of multiple runtime versions across projects via plugins, with automatic environment switching, project-level isolation, and seamless shell integration for simplified development workflows.

repos.description: Per object permissions for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-guardian 是 Django 的细粒度对象权限管理库，通过扩展 Django 的授权后端实现基于对象的权限控制。支持为单个模型实例分配权限，适用于需要复杂权限模型的应用场景，如多租户系统或内容协作平台。
repos.summary_en: django-guardian is a Django library implementing per-object permissions by extending Django's authorization backend. It enables fine-grained access control at the object level, allowing assignment of permissions to individual model instances—ideal for multi-tenant or collaborative applications requiring complex permission models.

repos.description: Intelligent Skill routing and workflow orchestration for AI agents — +21.12 pp reward, −29.6% tokens on SkillsBench with DeepSeekV4Flash-VE.
repos.summary_zh: VibeSkills 是一个集成340+ AI技能的操作系统级工具，覆盖编码、研究、自动化与创意工作。通过智能路由、记忆系统和治理验证，实现技能高效协同，显著降低使用门槛，让非技术用户也能轻松调用先进AI能力，提升生产力。
repos.summary_en: VibeSkills is an AI operating system integrating 340+ governed skills across coding, research, automation, and creative work. It enables efficient skill orchestration via intelligent routing, memory systems, and governance verification, dramatically lowering the barrier to advanced AI tool usage for both technical and non-technical users.

repos.description: 基于大模型的智能对话客服工具，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、哔哩哔哩、抖音企业号、抖音、抖店、微博聊天、小红书专业号运营、小红书、知乎等平台接入，可选择 GPT3.5/GPT4.0/ 懒人百宝箱 （后续会支持更多平台），能处理文本、语音和图片，通过插件访问操作系统和互联网等外部资源，支持基于自有知识库定制企业 AI 应用。
repos.summary_zh: 金销数据云智能客服是基于大语言模型的专业电商SaaS解决方案，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、抖音、小红书等10+主流平台接入，具备文本/语音/图片处理能力，支持自有知识库定制与插件扩展，提供多维度数据分析与意图识别功能。
repos.summary_en: JinXiao Data Cloud AI Customer Service is a professional e-commerce SaaS solution powered by large language models, supporting integration with 10+ mainstream platforms including WeChat, Pinduoduo, Qianniu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, with capabilities for text/voice/image processing, custom knowledge base configuration, plugin ecosystem, and multi-dimensional data analytics including intent recognition.

repos.summary_zh: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动化注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Cursor、Kiro、Grok 等平台的批量注册。基于 FastAPI + React 构建，具备插件化扩展能力，集成临时邮箱服务、代理池管理、验证码破解（Turnstile/Captcha）及并发控制功能，提供 Web UI 实时日志监控。
repos.summary_en: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account automation registration and management system supporting batch registration for platforms like Trae.ai, Cursor, Kiro, and Grok. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin-based extensibility, temporary email integration, proxy pool management, captcha solving (Turnstile/Captcha), concurrent execution control, and real-time SSE logging via web UI.

repos.description: Chrome扩展：支持OpenAI OAuth注册(自动开通plus账号)、验证码获取、CPA/sub/cpdex2api回调验证与自动恢复
repos.summary_zh: 该Chrome扩展专为批量自动化ChatGPT OAuth注册与登录流程设计，支持CPA面板授权获取、邮箱自动生成（DuckDuckGo/Cloudflare/Gmail/2925）、多类型验证码接收（QQ/163/Hotmail/Inbucket）及回调验证。具备单步执行、自动运行、日志追踪和配置保存功能，适用于大规模账号管理场景。
repos.summary_en: This Chrome extension automates bulk ChatGPT OAuth registration/login via CPA panel integration, supporting dynamic email generation (DuckDuckGo/Cloudflare/Gmail/2925), multi-source verification code retrieval (QQ/163/Hotmail/Inbucket), and callback validation. Features step-by-step control, auto-execution, logging, and config persistence for scalable account management.

repos.description: Simple tagging for django
repos.summary_zh: django-taggit 是一个为 Django 框架提供的简洁高效的标签管理库，支持通过 TaggableManager 轻松为模型添加标签功能，兼容 Django 3.2+，提供 API 操作、表单集成和后台管理支持，适用于内容分类与检索场景。
repos.summary_en: django-taggit is a simple and efficient tagging library for Django, enabling easy tag management via TaggableManager. It supports Django 3.2+, offers API-driven tag operations, form integration, and admin support, ideal for content categorization and retrieval.

repos.description: Auto-register & manage accounts for ChatGPT, Cursor, Kiro, Grok, Windsurf, Trae & 13+ AI platforms · Protocol/browser dual-mode · Plugin-based · One-click Mac/Windows desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动化注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Cursor、ChatGPT 等主流 AI 平台。采用 FastAPI + React 技术栈，具备插件化架构、邮箱服务集成（MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail）、验证码自动识别及代理池管理功能，提供 Web UI 实时管控并发注册任务。
repos.summary_en: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account automation registration and management system supporting AI platforms like Trae.ai, Cursor, and ChatGPT. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin architecture, integrated mailbox services (MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail), captcha solving, proxy pool management, and real-time SSE logging via web UI for concurrent task control.

repos.description: Django application and library for importing and exporting data with admin integration.
repos.summary_zh: django-import-export 是一个专为 Django 应用设计的强大数据导入导出库，支持 CSV、Excel、JSON 等多种格式，提供 Admin 后台集成和编程接口。核心功能包括数据预览、批量导入、CRUD 操作控制、外键与多对多关系处理、数据验证及自定义转换，适用于需要高效处理大规模数据迁移或批量操作的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-import-export is a robust Django library for importing and exporting data across multiple formats (CSV, Excel, JSON, etc.). It offers seamless Admin UI integration and programmatic access, featuring data preview, bulk import, CRUD control, foreign key/many-to-many relation handling, validation, and custom transformations—ideal for data migration and batch operations in Django applications.

repos.description: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension that allows you to specify, plan, and implement software features.
repos.summary_zh: Conductor 是 Gemini CLI 的扩展工具，通过上下文驱动开发（Context-Driven Development）实现软件功能的规范化生命周期管理。它支持在编码前制定详细规格与执行计划，确保代码质量与团队一致性，适用于新项目和现有项目的智能开发流程管控。
repos.summary_en: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

repos.summary_zh: 该仓库原为 MusicFree 插件生态的集中管理平台，现已被清空。原功能可能涉及音乐流媒体平台的插件集成、扩展支持及开发者工具分发，服务于跨平台音乐播放场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository was originally a centralized hub for MusicFree plugins, now cleared. It likely managed plugin integration and distribution for music streaming platforms, supporting cross-platform playback extensions.

repos.description: AList proxy server for TvBox, support playlist and search.
repos.summary_zh: AList-TvBox 是一个专为 TvBox 设计的 AList 代理服务器，支持播放列表生成与内容搜索功能。通过集成 AList 的文件管理能力，为电视盒子提供结构化视频资源访问接口，适用于家庭媒体中心场景。
repos.summary_en: AList-TvBox is an AList proxy server tailored for TvBox, enabling playlist generation and content search. It leverages AList's file management to deliver structured video resources to TV boxes, ideal for home media center setups.

repos.description: Chrome extension to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: Full featured redis cache backend for Django.
repos.summary_zh: django-redis 是一个功能完整的 Redis 缓存和会话后端，专为 Django 设计。它支持原生 redis-py URL 连接字符串、可插拔客户端/解析器/序列化器，提供主从支持、无限超时、Unix 套接字连接及原始 Redis 客户端访问，适用于高并发生产环境。
repos.summary_en: django-redis is a full-featured, BSD-licensed Redis cache and session backend for Django. It supports native redis-py URL connections, pluggable clients/parsers/serializers, primary/secondary setups, infinite timeouts, Unix sockets, and raw Redis client access, making it ideal for production-scale Django applications.

repos.description: 浸入式学语言助手 (Immersive Language Learning Assistant)
repos.summary_zh: 浸入式语言学习助手是一款基于‘可理解输入’理论的浏览器插件，通过智能翻译网页词汇并集成发音功能，实现自然语言习得。支持自动语言检测、AI选词、双语音频朗读及交互式提示，将整个互联网转化为个性化学习材料。
repos.summary_en: An immersive language learning browser extension based on 'comprehensible input' theory, intelligently translating selected words with pronunciation support. Features automatic language detection, AI-driven vocabulary selection, dual TTS, and interactive tooltips to turn the web into personalized learning content.

repos.description: LinuxDo Scripts 扩展，功能持续更新，欢迎提出新想法！已上架 Chrome Web Store 和 Firefox 商店！文档地址：https://linuxdo-scripts.zishu.me
repos.summary_zh: LinuxDo Scripts 是一款专为 LinuxDo 论坛设计的浏览器扩展，集成界面优化、AI 辅助发帖、收藏夹增强等实用功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，提供流畅的论坛交互体验，持续更新并兼容 idcflare.com 网站。
repos.summary_en: LinuxDo Scripts is a browser extension designed to enhance the LinuxDo forum experience, featuring interface optimization, AI-assisted posting, and enhanced favorites. Compatible with Chrome, Firefox, and other browsers, it offers seamless interaction and ongoing updates.

repos.summary_zh: Cursor Fake Machine 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VSIX 扩展工具，通过修改 machineid 实现机器信息伪装，帮助用户绕过设备限制或环境检测，适用于开发环境隔离与多实例管理场景。
repos.summary_en: Cursor Fake Machine is a VSIX extension for the Cursor editor that modifies the machineid to spoof device information, allowing users to bypass device restrictions or environment checks. It's useful for managing isolated development environments or multiple instances.

repos.description: Material Design for Django
repos.summary_zh: Django Material 是一个为 Django 框架打造的 Material Design 3 组件库，提供完整的 CRUD 和管理界面。它基于 TailwindCSS 和 django-cotton，无需构建步骤即可使用预编译的 CSS/JS，支持响应式、无障碍访问及 SPA 式导航，专为 AI 辅助开发优化，实现快速、现代化的 Django 前端开发。
repos.summary_en: Django Material brings Google's Material Design 3 to Django with full-featured CRUD and admin interfaces. Built on TailwindCSS and django-cotton, it offers zero-build, responsive, accessible components powered by Unpoly.js for seamless navigation. Designed for AI-assisted development, it enables rapid, modern frontend development in Django without React, Vue, or Angular.

repos.description: Minimal plugin that lets Claude Code call you on the phone.
repos.summary_zh: CallMe 是一个极简的 Claude Code 插件，允许通过电话在任务完成、卡住或需要决策时呼叫用户。支持多轮语音对话，兼容智能手机、智能手表等设备，并可通过 ngrok 实现远程 webhook 连接。
repos.summary_en: CallMe is a minimal plugin for Claude Code that enables phone calls to alert users when tasks are done, stuck, or require decisions. It supports multi-turn voice conversations via OpenAI's TTS/STT, works across smartphones and smartwatches, and uses ngrok for secure webhook tunneling.

repos.description: Pipelines: Versatile, UI-Agnostic OpenAI-Compatible Plugin Framework
repos.summary_zh: Pipelines 是 Open WebUI 推出的开源插件框架，支持在任意兼容 OpenAI API 的 UI 客户端中运行自定义 Python 工作流。它允许开发者通过轻量代码扩展功能，如实现 RAG、消息监控、翻译过滤等复杂逻辑，适用于需要高性能计算或定制化 AI 流程的场景。
repos.summary_en: Pipelines is an open-source plugin framework by Open WebUI that enables modular, customizable workflows for any UI client supporting OpenAI API specs. It allows developers to extend functionality with custom Python logic—such as RAG, message monitoring, or translation filters—ideal for offloading heavy computations from main instances.

repos.description: Modern theme for Django admin interface
repos.summary_zh: Django Suit 是一个现代化的 Django 管理后台主题，提供简洁美观的界面设计，显著提升 Django 管理员的使用体验。支持 v1 稳定版与 v2 开发版，具备响应式布局和增强的交互功能，适用于需要优化后台管理界面的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: Django Suit is a modern theme for the Django admin interface, offering a clean and enhanced UI to improve the admin experience. It supports both stable v1 and experimental v2 versions, featuring responsive design and improved usability for Django projects requiring a professional admin panel.

repos.description: 企业级 AI 编程助手，专为 研发协作 和 研发管理 场景而设计。
repos.summary_zh: MonkeyCode 是一款企业级 AI 编程助手，专为研发协作与管理场景设计，支持私有化部署与本地大模型接入，提供 IDE 对话式编程、代码补全、安全扫描及 Git 平台机器人能力，内置企业级管理面板用于审计管控与资源统一调度，兼顾效率与代码安全。
repos.summary_en: MonkeyCode is an enterprise-grade AI programming assistant designed for R&D collaboration and management. It supports private deployment, local LLM integration, and offline usage, offering IDE-based coding, intelligent completions, security scanning, Git platform bots, and a management panel for auditing, compliance, and centralized model usage control.

repos.description: Bootstrap 3 integration with Django.
repos.summary_zh: django-bootstrap3 是 Bootstrap 3 与 Django 的无缝集成库，提供简洁的模板标签（如 `bootstrap_form`）快速渲染响应式表单。现已进入维护模式，仅修复漏洞，建议新项目使用 Bootstrap 5 及对应包 django-bootstrap5。
repos.summary_en: django-bootstrap3 integrates Bootstrap 3 with Django via easy-to-use template tags like `bootstrap_form` for rapid responsive form rendering. Now in maintenance mode—only security fixes—with recommended migration to django-bootstrap5 for new projects.

repos.description: Check酱：监测网页内容变化，并发送异动到微信。亦支持http status、json和rss监测。配合自架云端，关电脑后也能运行。
repos.summary_zh: Check酱是一款网页内容监控工具，支持通过浏览器插件监测网页内容变化，并将异动推送至微信等消息通道。支持HTTP状态、JSON和RSS监测，配合自建云端服务可实现24小时运行。具备可视化选择器、周期任务调度及多平台部署能力。
repos.summary_en: Check酱 is a web content monitoring tool that detects changes on web pages via a browser plugin and sends alerts to WeChat or other channels. It supports HTTP status, JSON, and RSS monitoring, with optional cloud deployment for continuous operation. Features include visual selector, scheduled tasks, and multi-platform support.

repos.description: 🎒 钉钉 & 🤖 GPT-3.5 让你的工作效率直接起飞 🚀 私聊群聊方式、单聊串聊模式、角色扮演、图片创作 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go语言开发的钉钉ChatGPT机器人，集成GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini模型，支持私聊、群聊、角色扮演、图片生成等功能，提供Docker部署和Azure-OpenAI支持，显著提升办公沟通效率。
repos.summary_en: A Go-based ChatGPT bot integrated with DingTalk, supporting GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini models, featuring private/group chat, role-playing, image generation, and Azure-OpenAI compatibility via Docker deployment for enhanced workplace productivity.

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: MobaXterm Key Generate
repos.summary_zh: MobaXterm Keygen & Customizer 是一个现代化的 Web 工具，用于生成 MobaXterm 激活密钥并自定义终端设置。支持多版本兼容（v20.X/v25.4/v26.0）、主题切换、用户数配置、自定义 Logo、书签管理及插件集成，提供一键下载与文件合并功能，极大简化了 MobaXterm 的授权与个性化部署流程。
repos.summary_en: MobaXterm Keygen & Customizer is a modern web tool for generating activation keys and customizing the MobaXterm terminal emulator. It supports multiple editions, user count configuration, dark/light themes, custom logos, bookmarks, and plugin integration, enabling one-click downloads and merged license-customization deployment for streamlined setup.

repos.description: A clock-style timepicker for Bootstrap (or jQuery). Sorry but no longer maintained.
repos.summary_zh: ClockPicker 是一个基于 Bootstrap 或 jQuery 的类时钟风格时间选择器，提供直观的时钟界面用于时间输入。支持桌面和移动设备，兼容 IE9+，具备自动关闭、12/24小时制切换、回调函数等丰富功能，适用于需要美观时间选择器的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: ClockPicker is a clock-style timepicker built for Bootstrap or jQuery, offering an intuitive analog clock interface for time selection. It supports major browsers including IE9+, works on both desktop and mobile devices, and provides features like autoclose, 12/24-hour modes, and customizable callbacks for enhanced user experience.

repos.description: A collapsible jQuery menu plugin
repos.summary_zh: metismenu 是一个轻量级 jQuery 插件，用于创建可折叠的侧边栏菜单。支持现代浏览器，提供流畅的展开/折叠动画，具备 ARIA 可访问性支持，可通过 CSS 类（如 has-arrow）自定义箭头样式，适用于后台管理系统等需要多级导航的场景。
repos.summary_en: MetisMenu is a lightweight jQuery plugin for creating collapsible sidebar menus. It supports modern browsers only, offers smooth expand/collapse animations, includes ARIA accessibility features, and allows customization via CSS classes like has-arrow, making it ideal for admin dashboards and multi-level navigation systems.

repos.description: 🤖 叮当是一款可以工作在 Raspberry Pi 上的中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目。
repos.summary_zh: 叮当是一款专为树莓派设计的开源中文语音对话机器人/智能音箱项目，支持模块化插件扩展、微信远程操控、多平台语音识别与合成技术，并集成智能家居控制功能，旨在帮助中国开发者快速构建个性化智能设备。
repos.summary_en: Dingdang is an open-source Chinese voice dialogue robot/smart speaker project designed for Raspberry Pi, featuring modular plugins, WeChat integration, multi-platform STT/TTS support, and smart home control, enabling developers to easily build personalized voice assistants.

repos.description: Markdown 批量导出工具、开放式跨平台博客解决方案，随意组合写作平台(语雀/Notion/FlowUs/飞书/我来Wolai)和博客平台(Hexo/Vitepress/Halo/Confluence/WordPress等)
repos.summary_zh: Elog 是一个开放式跨平台博客解决方案，支持将语雀、Notion、飞书等写作平台与 Hexo、VitePress、WordPress 等博客平台自由组合。它通过 Markdown 批量导出和图床上传功能，打通内容创作与发布的壁垒，提供灵活的文档处理适配器与插件生态，满足开发者与内容创作者的多场景需求。
repos.summary_en: Elog is an open-source cross-platform blogging solution that enables flexible integration between writing platforms (e.g., Notion, Yuque, Feishu) and blog engines (e.g., Hexo, VitePress, WordPress). It supports bulk Markdown export, image hosting via multiple cloud providers, customizable adapters, and extensible plugins to streamline content publishing workflows.

repos.description: [废弃] {官方中文马上就来了} GitHub 汉化插件，GitHub 中文化界面。 (GitHub Translation To Chinese)
repos.summary_zh: GitHub 汉化插件为英文基础薄弱用户提供中文界面支持，通过 Tampermonkey 实现 GitHub 全站翻译，帮助新手快速上手。插件每日自动更新翻译内容，支持 Chrome、Opera 等主流浏览器，并提供手动安装指南。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Hans is a Tampermonkey-based plugin that translates GitHub's full interface into Chinese, aiding users with limited English proficiency. It auto-updates translations daily and supports major browsers like Chrome and Opera, with clear installation instructions.

repos.description: Chat2API enables zero-cost access to leading AI models by leveraging official web UIs. It supports providers such as DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and Z.ai, and seamlessly integrates with tools like openlcaw, Cline, and Roo-Code.
repos.summary_zh: Chat2API 是一款跨平台 AI 服务统一管理工具，通过官方 Web UI 实现零成本接入 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、MiniMax、Qwen、Z.ai 等主流大模型。支持 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，无缝集成 openlcaw、Cline、Roo-Code 等开发工具，提供上下文管理、函数调用、模型映射等高级功能，并配备实时监控仪表盘与代理配置能力。
repos.summary_en: Chat2API is a cross-platform unified management tool for AI services, enabling zero-cost access to leading models like DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and Z.ai via official web UIs. It provides OpenAI-compatible APIs, seamless integration with tools such as openlcaw, Cline, and Roo-Code, advanced features like context management, function calling, model mapping, and real-time monitoring dashboard with proxy support.

repos.description: MCP server that provides tools and resources for interacting with n8n API
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供了一个基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的服务器，使 AI 助手能够通过自然语言与 n8n 工作流自动化平台进行交互。核心功能包括通过 API 管理 n8n 工作流、触发执行、获取状态等，支持 Docker 部署和 npm 安装，适用于 AI 驱动的流程自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides an MCP server enabling AI assistants to interact with n8n workflows via natural language. It allows programmatic management of n8n workflows and executions through its API, supporting deployment via npm or Docker. Key use cases include AI-driven workflow automation and integration.

repos.description: Google Assistant for macOS!
repos.summary_zh: MacAssistant 是一款将 Google Assistant 集成到 macOS 的 Swift 应用，支持语音交互与系统控制。通过 Google Assistant SDK 实现自然语言处理，支持天气查询、日程管理等常见指令，需用户自行配置 OAuth 凭证。项目采用 Swift 4.2 开发，基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers，提供跨平台语音助手解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MacAssistant is a Swift-based macOS app integrating Google Assistant via the Google Assistant SDK, enabling voice interaction and system control. It supports natural language queries like weather and agenda, requiring user-provided OAuth credentials. Built with Swift 4.2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers, it offers a cross-platform voice assistant solution for macOS.

repos.description: A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. It doesn't need any kind of modification on your side, just add it to the installed apps.
repos.summary_zh: django-admin-bootstrapped 是一个为 Django 管理后台提供 Twitter Bootstrap 主题的插件，无需修改现有代码即可集成。它支持 Bootstrap 3 样式渲染、可拖拽排序内联表单、自定义 HTML 注入及 XHTML 兼容，显著提升管理界面的视觉体验与交互性。
repos.summary_en: django-admin-bootstrapped is a Django admin theme powered by Twitter Bootstrap, requiring no code changes—just add it to INSTALLED_APPS. It offers Bootstrap 3 styling, drag-and-drop sortable inlines, custom HTML injection, XHTML compatibility, and enhanced message alerts for a modern admin interface.

repos.description: Responsive Image Maps jQuery Plugin
repos.summary_zh: jQuery RWD Image Maps 是一个响应式图像地图插件，通过动态重计算坐标，使 HTML 图像映射在窗口缩放或图像尺寸变化时保持精准定位，适用于响应式网页设计中的交互式图像区域。
repos.summary_en: jQuery RWD Image Maps is a responsive image maps plugin that recalculates area coordinates dynamically to maintain accurate clickable regions when images resize, ideal for interactive responsive web designs using HTML image maps.

repos.description: Old Celery integration project for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-celery 是 Celery 与 Django 的集成项目，专为 Celery v3.x 至 v4.x 设计，提供基于 Django ORM 和缓存的结果存储、任务模块自动发现及后台管理功能。现已停止维护，推荐使用新版 Celery 教程替代。
repos.summary_en: django-celery is a legacy integration project for Celery with Django, supporting Celery v3.x to v4.x only. It enables Django ORM-based result storage, automatic task discovery, and admin integration. The project is no longer actively maintained; users are advised to follow the updated Celery Django tutorial.

repos.description: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF-extensions 是 Django REST Framework 的扩展集合，提供 DetailSerializerMixin、缓存、条件请求、嵌套路由和批量操作等核心功能，支持多版本 Django 和 DRF，文档完善，适合企业级 API 开发。
repos.summary_en: DRF-extensions is a collection of custom extensions for Django REST Framework, offering features like DetailSerializerMixin, caching, conditional requests, nested routes, and bulk operations. It supports multiple Django and DRF versions with comprehensive documentation, ideal for enterprise-grade API development.

repos.description: Obsidian Plugin to execute code in a note.
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Execute Code 插件支持在笔记中直接运行代码块，提供一键执行、交互式输入和结果展示功能。目前已支持 Python、R、Octave 等 30+ 种编程语言，并支持魔法命令、全局代码注入及持久化输出（实验性）。适用于数据科学、教学演示和自动化脚本场景。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Execute Code plugin enables direct execution of code blocks within notes, featuring one-click run buttons, interactive input prompts, and real-time output display. It supports over 30 languages including Python, R, and Octave, with magic commands, global code injections, and experimental persistent output for PDF export. Ideal for data science, teaching, and scripting workflows.

repos.description: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
repos.summary_zh: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。它支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），并提供字幕导航、多播放模式（快进/跳过无字幕片段）、自动暂停等功能，帮助用户高效创建多媒体闪卡并优化语言学习体验。
repos.summary_en: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled content. It enables loading selectable subtitles from streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports subtitle navigation, playback modes (e.g., condensed/fast-forward), and integrates with tools like Yomitan for word styling and annotation to enhance vocabulary acquisition.

repos.description: Agent-native AI assistant — chat, write, whiteboard, learning, all in one.
repos.summary_zh: YOLO 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的智能 AI 助手插件，支持 Agent 模式、多窗口对话和知识库问答。通过工具调用与自定义技能实现自动化操作，结合 RAG 技术将整个知识库作为上下文，提供多语言、多模型支持的流畅写作与任务处理体验。
repos.summary_en: YOLO is an intelligent, multilingual AI assistant plugin for Obsidian, featuring Agent mode with tool calling and custom skills, multi-window chat, RAG-powered knowledge base Q&A, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other mainstream LLMs.

repos.description: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Colorpicker 是一个专为 Bootstrap 4 设计的模块化颜色选择插件，支持 jQuery 和 Bootstrap CSS/JS。它提供灵活的颜色选择功能，兼容 v2.x（Bootstrap 3/4）和 v3.x（Bootstrap 4 或无 Bootstrap）版本，适用于网页颜色输入场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap 4, built with jQuery and optional Bootstrap CSS/JS. It supports v2.x (Bootstrap 3/4) and v3.x (Bootstrap 4 or standalone), offering flexible color selection for web applications. Available via npm, yarn, or direct download.

repos.description: 微信公众平台 Python 开发包 [DEPRECATED]
repos.summary_zh: wechat-python-sdk 是一个已停止维护的微信公众平台 Python 开发包，支持订阅号和服务号官方接口，提供消息处理、加解密、模板消息等功能。该 SDK 设计为轻量级，便于集成到各类 Web 框架中，不处理 HTTP 请求响应，仅封装微信 API 操作并返回合规响应数据。
repos.summary_en: wechat-python-sdk was a deprecated Python SDK for WeChat Official Accounts (subscription/service accounts), offering message handling, encryption/decryption, template messages, and menu management. It focused on simplifying WeChat API integration by returning compliant response data without handling HTTP layers, designed for easy integration into web frameworks.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

repos.description: WebSockets for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-socketio 是一个 BSD 许可的 Django 应用，通过集成 gevent-socketio 实现 WebSocket 支持，提供频道订阅、事件广播和信号式事件系统，支持实时通信与自动重载服务器，适用于需要实时交互的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-socketio is a BSD-licensed Django application that enables WebSocket support via gevent-socketio, offering channel-based subscriptions, event broadcasting, and a signals-like event system for real-time communication in Django projects.

repos.description: ❤️‍🔥 A chrome extension as an alternative to Notion AI that goes beyond Notion AI. | 一个替代 Notion AI 的浏览器插件，不止于 Notion AI
repos.summary_zh: Writely 是一款基于 OpenAI GPT 模型的浏览器插件，旨在替代 Notion AI。它支持在任意网页编辑器中提供智能写作辅助、邮件撰写、文章创作及社交媒体互动等功能，显著提升用户的内容创作效率与质量，实现跨平台的智能文本处理体验。
repos.summary_en: Writely is a browser extension powered by OpenAI's GPT model, designed as an alternative to Notion AI. It enables intelligent writing assistance across any webpage editor, supporting email composition, article drafting, and social media interactions, thereby enhancing content creation efficiency and quality with cross-platform accessibility.

repos.description: Awesome AI GPTs, OpenAI GPTs, GPT-4, ChatGPT, GPTs, Prompts, plugins, Prompts leaking
repos.summary_zh: Awesome AI GPTs 是一个精选的 OpenAI GPTs 资源库，涵盖提示词工程、内容创作、编程辅助、数据分析等场景。项目提供热门 GPTs 推荐、插件安装指南、知识库构建工具及安全防护方案，助力用户高效利用 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

repos.description: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
repos.summary_zh: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），提供可导航的字幕列表、多种播放模式（如跳过无字幕片段、自动暂停）以及高质量多媒体闪卡生成功能，显著提升语言学习效率。
repos.summary_en: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled videos. It enables loading selectable subtitles onto streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports navigable subtitle lists, condensed playback modes, and multimedia flashcard creation to optimize vocabulary acquisition.

repos.description: Gemini Nexus 是一款面向浏览器场景的 AI 助手扩展，集成 Gemini Web、Gemini API 与 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持网页上下文、图像处理、工具调用和 MCP 浏览器控制。
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理及浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，实现网页交互的智能化增强。支持多驱动 API（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容）、上下文管理、历史消息编辑及基于 DevTools Protocol 的自动化操作，为浏览器内 AI 工作流提供原生级体验。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Nexus is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini, featuring an injected floating toolbar, image AI processing, and browser control via MCP. It supports multiple API drivers (Web Client/Official/OpenAI Compatible), context management, message history editing, and automation through Chrome DevTools Protocol for native AI-enhanced browsing workflows.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Next.js 的对话型 Web 应用模板，专为集成 Dify AI 平台设计。支持通过环境变量配置 APP ID、API Key 和接口地址，提供 Docker 部署方案，具备多语言支持和自定义提示词功能，适用于快速构建企业级智能对话界面。
repos.summary_en: This is a Next.js-based conversational web app template designed for Dify AI platform integration. It supports configuration via environment variables (APP ID, API Key, URL), offers Docker deployment, multi-language support, and customizable prompts, enabling rapid development of enterprise-grade AI chat interfaces.

repos.description: A simple yet powerful JQuery star rating plugin with fractional rating support.
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap-star-rating 是一款基于 jQuery 的 Bootstrap 星级评分插件，支持分数评级、RTL 方向及纯 CSS3 矢量图标渲染。它可自动将输入框转换为评分控件，兼容 Bootstrap 3/4/5，并支持 FontAwesome 等字体图标库，适用于需要灵活星级评分功能的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: bootstrap-star-rating is a jQuery plugin for Bootstrap that enables star rating controls with fractional support, RTL compatibility, and pure CSS3 styling. It auto-converts inputs marked with class 'rating', supports Bootstrap 3/4/5, and integrates with font icon libraries like FontAwesome for scalable vector star symbols.

repos.summary_zh: Augment 插件清理工具 v3.4 是一款专为解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件登录失败问题而设计的跨平台工具。核心功能包括彻底清理插件缓存数据、生成设备 SessionId，以及通过智能测速优化 API 域名解析（将 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 指向延迟最低服务器）。支持交互式菜单和命令行模式，提供代理配置、安全预览等高级功能，兼容 Windows/macOS/Linux。
repos.summary_en: Augment Plugin Cleaner v3.4 is a cross-platform utility designed to resolve login failures in Augment plugin for VSCode, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs. It features comprehensive cache/data cleanup, SessionId generation, and intelligent API domain optimization by testing latency of d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com endpoints. Supports interactive menus, CLI arguments, proxy configurations (Clash/V2Ray/custom), dry-run previews, and works on Windows/macOS/Linux with admin privileges for hosts file modification.

repos.description: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序。它不仅仅是一个侧边栏插件，而是通过注入式的悬浮工具栏、强大的图像 AI 处理以及前沿的浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，将 AI 的触角伸向网页浏览的每一个交互细节。
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini AI 的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理和浏览器控制协议 (MCP) 实现网页交互的智能增强。支持三种驱动方案（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容），提供划词翻译、OCR截图翻译、水印消除等功能，并基于 Accessibility Tree 实现精准页面操作。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Nexus is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini AI, enhancing web browsing through an injected floating toolbar, image AI processing, and Browser Control Protocol (MCP). It supports three provider modes (Web Client/Official API/OpenAI Compatible), offering features like text selection translation, OCR screenshot translation, watermark removal, and precise page control via Accessibility Tree.
