repos.description: A jQuery tag/token input plugin for Twitter's Bootstrap, by the guys from Sliptree
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tokenfield 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签输入插件，支持键盘操作、复制粘贴、自动补全集成等功能。虽然项目已停止维护，但仍可用于需要轻量级标签输入的场景，尤其适合与 Bootstrap 3+ 和 jQuery 1.9+ 配合使用。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tokenfield is a jQuery plugin for tag/token input built on Twitter Bootstrap, supporting keyboard navigation, copy-paste, and integration with autocomplete/typeahead. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for lightweight tagging in Bootstrap 3+ environments with jQuery 1.9+.

repos.description: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

repos.description: 专为tmailor调教，古法永动机版本！（支持duck/33mail/tmailor）
repos.summary_zh: Infinitoai 是一款基于 Chrome Side Panel 的自动化扩展，专为 OpenAI OAuth 注册/登录流程设计。支持 Duck、33mail、TMailor 多邮箱源及 QQ/163/Inbucket 等验证码收件通道，具备完整工作流编排、自动重试、失败统计与人工接管能力，适用于批量验证与自动化测试场景。
repos.summary_en: Infinitoai is a Chrome Side Panel extension automating OpenAI OAuth registration/login workflows. It supports multiple email sources (Duck, 33mail, TMailor) and verification channels (QQ/163/Inbucket), featuring full workflow orchestration, auto-retry, failure tracking, and manual intervention capabilities for batch validation and testing.

repos.description: 移动端响应式插件
repos.summary_zh: 移动端响应式插件通过transform:scale实现页面缩放适配，支持contain/cover/auto三种模式，兼容iOS4+与Android2.3+等老旧系统。采用视觉稿px单位直接适配，无需rem或媒体查询，零依赖仅1KB，适合单屏滑屏H5页面开发。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight mobile responsive plugin using transform:scale for device adaptation. Supports contain/cover/auto modes with excellent legacy browser support (iOS4+/Android2.3+). Uses visual design px units directly without rem or media queries, ideal for single-screen H5 apps.

repos.description: A customizable plug-in photo gallery management application for the Django web framework.
repos.summary_zh: Django-photologue 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的强大图片管理与画廊应用，支持上传照片、创建画廊、添加水印等效果，提供灵活的插件化架构，适用于构建定制化图片展示网站。
repos.summary_en: Django-photologue is a powerful image management and gallery application for Django, enabling photo uploads, gallery organization, watermarking, and flexible customization for web-based photo displays.

repos.description: 一款手势驱动的裁图插件 / A gesture to drive image cropping plug-in
repos.summary_zh: PhotoClip.js 是一款手势驱动的移动端图片裁剪插件，支持双指缩放、旋转等直观操作，兼容主流浏览器。通过集成 iscroll-zoom、hammer.js 和 lrz 压缩库，实现高效图片裁剪与压缩，适用于移动端照片处理场景，提供灵活的配置选项和回调机制。
repos.summary_en: PhotoClip.js is a gesture-driven image cropping plugin for mobile devices, supporting intuitive pinch-to-zoom and rotation. It integrates iscroll-zoom, hammer.js, and lrz compression for efficient image processing. Compatible with modern browsers, it offers flexible configuration and callbacks for mobile photo editing workflows.

repos.description: cxSelect 是基于 jQuery 的多级联动菜单插件，适用于省市、商品分类等联动菜单。
repos.summary_zh: cxSelect 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Zepto 的多级联动菜单插件，支持通过 AJAX 或自定义 JSON 数据动态加载省市、商品分类等层级选项，兼容移动端，提供灵活的参数配置与 API 控制，适用于表单联动场景。
repos.summary_en: cxSelect is a jQuery and Zepto-based plugin for multi-level cascading menus, supporting dynamic loading of hierarchical options (e.g., provinces, cities) via AJAX or custom JSON data. It offers flexible configuration, mobile compatibility, and full API control for form interactions.

repos.description: A minimal django project containing a minimal app with a working jquery file upload form based on the work by Sebastian Tschan: http://aquantum-demo.appspot.com/file-upload
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Sebastian Tschan 的 jQuery-File-Upload 组件的极简 Django 文件上传示例，支持拖拽上传、多文件选择、上传取消及文件删除功能，无需 Flash 等浏览器插件，适用于快速集成前端文件上传到 Django 后端。
repos.summary_en: This is a minimal Django project demonstrating how to integrate Sebastian Tschan's jQuery-File-Upload component, featuring drag-and-drop, multi-file selection, upload cancellation, and file deletion. It requires no browser plugins like Flash and is ideal for quickly adding robust file upload functionality to Django applications.

repos.description: Share obsidian markdown file to notion and generate notion share link    同步obsdian文件到notion，并生成notion分享链接，可以方便的分享obsidian的文件。
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian to Notion 插件实现一键将 Obsidian Markdown 文件同步至 Notion，自动生成分享链接。支持自定义封面、标签转换、页面更新及多语言，集成 Notion API，适用于知识管理与协作分享。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian to Notion plugin enables one-click syncing of Obsidian Markdown files to Notion with automatic share link generation. It supports custom banners, tag conversion, page updates, and multilingual features via Notion API integration for knowledge management and collaboration.

repos.description: 一个简单的Chrome插件，用来帮助你登录ChatGPT。
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT Auth Helper 是一个 Chrome 浏览器插件，旨在简化用户通过第三方认证服务（如 https://token.oaifree.com/auth）登录 ChatGPT 的流程。该插件提供一键式身份验证支持，提升访问效率，适用于需要频繁使用 ChatGPT 的用户群体。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT Auth Helper is a lightweight Chrome extension designed to simplify the login process for ChatGPT via third-party authentication services like https://token.oaifree.com/auth. It streamlines access by automating token-based logins, enhancing convenience for frequent users.

repos.description: Bootstrap-themed jquery tag interface
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tags 是一个 jQuery 插件，用于扩展 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签功能，支持 Bootstrap 2.3.2 和 3+ 版本。它提供自动建议、排除/过滤列表、占位符提示、Bootstrap 按钮样式集成以及可自定义的扩展点，适用于需要交互式标签输入的 Web 表单场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tags is a jQuery plugin that extends Twitter Bootstrap with tagging functionality, supporting Bootstrap 2.3.2 and 3+. It features autosuggest, exclusion/filtering, popovers, placeholder prompts, and Bootstrap button styling, making it ideal for interactive tag-based input in web forms.

repos.description: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
repos.summary_zh: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
repos.summary_en: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

repos.description: Scrapy extension to write scraped items using Django models
repos.summary_zh: scrapy-djangoitem 是一个 Scrapy 扩展，允许使用 Django 模型定义 Scrapy 项目中的 Item。它提供 DjangoItem 类，将 Django 模型字段自动映射为 Scrapy Item 字段，并支持通过 save() 方法将抓取数据直接保存为 Django 模型实例，简化了爬虫与 Django 应用的数据集成。
repos.summary_en: scrapy-djangoitem is a Scrapy extension that enables defining Scrapy items using existing Django models. It provides the DjangoItem class, which automatically maps Django model fields to Scrapy item fields and supports saving scraped data directly into Django model instances via the save() method, streamlining integration between Scrapy crawlers and Django applications.

repos.description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
repos.summary_zh: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级两步验证密钥管理系统，支持 TOTP/HOTP 生成、多方式添加密钥（扫码/图片识别/拖拽/粘贴）、AES-256-GCM 加密存储，兼容主流应用批量导入导出，具备 WebDAV/S3 远程同步、自动备份还原及响应式设计，实现免费全球部署与离线 PWA 使用。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight two-factor authentication (2FA) key management system built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TOTP/HOTP generation, multi-method key addition (QR scan/image recognition/drag-and-drop/paste), AES-256-GCM encryption, batch import/export from major apps, WebDAV/S3 sync, auto backup/restore, and responsive design for offline PWA use with global free deployment.

repos.description: 智能替换网页词汇，创造沉浸式双语学习环境，在日常浏览中自然习得语言。
repos.summary_zh: VocabMeld 是一款 Chrome 插件，基于可理解性输入理论，通过智能替换网页词汇为母语翻译，创造沉浸式双语学习环境。支持多 LLM 服务（DeepSeek、OpenAI 等），CEFR 难度分级，LRU 缓存加速，本地存储保障隐私，提供强度与样式自定义选项，让语言学习自然融入日常浏览。
repos.summary_en: VocabMeld is a Chrome extension that creates an immersive bilingual learning environment by intelligently replacing webpage vocabulary with translations. Built on the 'comprehensible input' theory, it supports multiple LLMs (DeepSeek, OpenAI, etc.), CEFR-level filtering, LRU caching for speed, local storage for privacy, and customizable intensity/styles for natural language acquisition during daily browsing.

repos.description: DjangoUeditor
repos.summary_zh: DjangoUeditor 是一个用于在 Django 项目中集成百度 UEditor 富文本编辑器的 Python 模块，支持强大的 HTML 编辑功能（如拖拽调整表格单元格），提供灵活的上传路径配置和自定义按钮扩展，适用于内容管理系统、博客等富文本编辑场景。
repos.summary_en: DjangoUeditor is a Python module that integrates Baidu UEditor, a powerful online HTML editor, into Django applications. It supports advanced editing features like drag-and-drop table cells and offers flexible image/file upload configurations, custom buttons, and admin integration, ideal for CMS and blog platforms.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过 GitHub Actions 实现豆瓣电影和读书数据的自动化同步至 Notion，支持每日定时抓取与更新。提供网页预览效果，集成微信公众号教程与用户交流群，具备完善的社区支持和持续迭代计划。
repos.summary_en: This project automates daily synchronization of Douban movies and books to Notion via GitHub Actions, featuring web previews, WeChat-based tutorials, user communities, and ongoing updates with donation support.

repos.description: ProxyLLM是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话把多种 LLM网站的能力统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API, 一键应用到Claude Code (ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that captures browser sessions to unify the capabilities of multiple LLM websites into an OpenAI-compatible API, enabling one-click integration with Claude Code)
repos.summary_zh: ProxyLLM 是一款本地 Electron 应用，通过捕获浏览器会话将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 等多平台 LLM 服务统一为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持一键集成 Claude Code。具备多站点管理、凭据自动捕获、OAuth 登录、动态模型发现及本地持久化日志等功能，提供完整的 OpenAI 格式接口与 Anthropic 原生 API 支持。
repos.summary_en: ProxyLLM is a local Electron application that unifies multiple LLM platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) into an OpenAI-compatible API by capturing browser sessions. It enables one-click integration with Claude Code, featuring multi-site management, automatic credential capture, OAuth login, dynamic model discovery, and local persistence, exposing both OpenAI-style and native Anthropic APIs.

repos.description: Douban Search App Based on React Native
repos.summary_zh: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
repos.summary_en: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

repos.description: Automated Grok (x.ai) account registration with DuckMail + headless server support. Auto-push SSO tokens to grok2api.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 DrissionPage 的 Grok (x.ai) 账号自动化注册工具，集成 DuckMail 临时邮箱与 Chrome 扩展修复 CDP 缺陷绕过 Cloudflare Turnstile。支持无头服务器部署（Xvfb + playwright chromium），自动推送 SSO token 至 grok2api 号池，具备中英文界面适配与代理配置能力。
repos.summary_en: Automated Grok (x.ai) account registration tool using DrissionPage, DuckMail temporary emails, and Chrome extension patch to bypass Cloudflare Turnstile via CDP MouseEvent fix. Supports headless Linux deployment with Xvfb, auto-pushes SSO tokens to grok2api pool, includes proxy support and bilingual UI.

repos.description: Django markdown support and wysiwig
repos.summary_zh: Django-Markdown 是一个为 Django 框架提供 Markdown 富文本编辑支持的扩展应用，支持在模型字段、表单、管理后台及静态页面中集成所见即所得（WYSIWYG）编辑器，内置预览功能和可配置扩展，适用于内容管理系统（CMS）和文档类 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Django-Markdown is a Django app enabling Markdown WYSIWYG editing in models, forms, admin interfaces, and flatpages. It integrates a rich text editor with preview functionality, configurable extensions, and admin overrides, ideal for CMS and documentation-driven web applications.

repos.description: The first browser AI Agent extension to support Agent Skills, enabling AI to perform complex tasks through an expandable skill system. 🌟 Star if you like it! | 首个支持 Agent Skills 的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，让 AI 通过可扩展技能系统执行复杂任务 🌟 如果喜欢请点个 Star！
repos.summary_zh: Tactus 是首个支持 Agent Skills 规范的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，通过可扩展技能系统让 AI 执行复杂任务。支持多模型对话、网页内容理解、图像识别及 HTTP MCP 外部工具集成，具备脚本安全执行与信任机制，实现高效自动化操作。
repos.summary_en: Tactus is the first browser AI Agent extension implementing the Agent Skills specification, enabling complex task execution via an extensible skill system. It supports multi-model conversations, page understanding, vision capabilities, and HTTP MCP integration, with secure script execution and user trust controls for efficient automation.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到企业微信，无须VPN，速度快
repos.summary_zh: 本项目实现零代码一键部署ChatGPT至企业微信，无需翻墙，支持手机端与电脑端使用。基于OpenAI API构建，提供智能问答、客服自动化等能力，适用于企业内部沟通、客户服务及营销场景，大幅降低沟通成本并提升效率。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into WeCom (WeChat Enterprise), with no need for VPN. It integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT API to deliver intelligent Q&A and automated customer service, enhancing internal communication and business efficiency across mobile and desktop platforms.

repos.description: Hexo七牛同步插件
repos.summary_zh: Hexo七牛同步插件是一个专为Hexo博客设计的自动化工具，支持将本地静态资源（图片、JS、CSS）自动同步至七牛云存储，无需手动上传。通过配置实现一键部署，支持图片处理、缩略图生成及离线预览，提升博客资源管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Hexo Qiniu Sync is an automation plugin for Hexo blogs that synchronizes local static assets (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage. It enables one-click deployment with image processing, thumbnail generation, and offline preview support, streamlining resource management.

repos.description: 一个用于重新生成 Cursor 设备 ID 和设置 Access Token 的 Cursor 扩展
repos.summary_zh: Fake Cursor 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VS Code 扩展，支持重新生成设备 ID、修补机器码获取逻辑及设置 Access Token，实现多账号共用同一设备。支持 0.45.x~0.46.x 版本，具备使用情况监控、自动备份配置等功能，适用于 Windows/macOS/Linux 系统。
repos.summary_en: Fake Cursor is a VS Code extension for Cursor editor that enables device ID regeneration, machine code patching, and Access Token configuration to allow multiple accounts on one device. Supports Cursor 0.45.x-0.46.x, featuring usage monitoring, config backup, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux).

repos.description: 基于Outlook Email的Chrome扩展：支持OpenAI OAuth古法注册与账号标签管理
repos.summary_zh: 基于Chrome MV3扩展的OpenAI OAuth自动化注册工具，集成Outlook邮箱平台API实现邮箱可视化管理、验证码轮询回填及自动标签标记。支持自建多域名邮箱资源（如Gmail、QQ、163等），提供Side Panel交互界面与完整9步注册流程，确保账号唯一性与流程可追溯性。
repos.summary_en: A Chrome MV3 extension automating OpenAI OAuth registration via Outlook Email API, featuring visual mailbox management, captcha polling/reply, and auto-tagging. Supports multi-domain email resources (Gmail, QQ, 163, etc.) with Side Panel UI and full 9-step flow for reliable account tracking.

repos.description: Assistant for get HTTP ONLY Cookies.
repos.summary_zh: GetCookies 是一款 Chrome 扩展插件，专为突破 HTTP ONLY 限制而设计，可安全获取指定域下的 Cookie 数据。通过自定义 DOM 属性触发 Cookie 提取，支持跨域、指定名称与域名，并通过 postMessage 机制实现安全的跨页面通信，适用于自动化登录与数据抓取场景。
repos.summary_en: GetCookies is a Chrome extension that bypasses HTTP ONLY restrictions to securely extract cookies from specified domains. It triggers cookie retrieval via custom DOM attributes, supports cross-domain access, allows naming and domain filtering, and uses postMessage for safe cross-page communication, ideal for automation and login workflows.

repos.description: 🚀 UniHub - 现代化的跨平台工具集应用，支持强大的插件系统 | Modern cross-platform toolkit with powerful plugin system
repos.summary_zh: UniHub 是基于 Electron 的现代化跨平台工具集应用，采用 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite 技术栈，配备强大的插件系统和内置插件市场。支持动态插件加载、细粒度权限管理、自动更新检测等功能，提供优雅的 Tailwind CSS 界面和全局快捷键操作体验。
repos.summary_en: UniHub is a modern cross-platform toolkit built with Electron, Vue 3, TypeScript, and Vite. It features a powerful plugin system with dynamic loading, granular permission control, built-in marketplace, and automatic update detection. The app offers an elegant UI powered by Tailwind CSS and global keyboard shortcuts for enhanced productivity.

repos.description: Audit log for your Django models
repos.summary_zh: django-audit-log 是一个 Django 模型审计日志库，提供用户追踪、变更记录和会话信息存储功能。支持 Django 1.6/1.7 及多版本 Python，通过中间件自动记录模型创建与修改操作，适用于需要完整操作历史追溯的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-audit-log is a Django model audit logging library that tracks user actions, changes, and session keys for model instances. It supports Django 1.6/1.7, South and Django 1.7 migrations, and both Python 2.x and 3.x, enabling full audit trails for data modifications in web applications.

repos.description: Get Inspired by the World's Greatest Artworks Every Time You Open a New Tab. Extension Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
repos.summary_zh: Artab 是一款浏览器扩展，每次打开新标签页时展示世界顶级艺术作品，为用户提供每日艺术灵感。支持 Chrome、Edge 和 Firefox，基于现代前端技术栈开发，具备本地存储管理和跨浏览器兼容特性。
repos.summary_en: Artab is a browser extension that displays world-class artworks on every new tab, inspiring users with daily art inspiration. Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, it features modern frontend architecture with local storage and cross-browser compatibility.

repos.description: Django template tag for rendering Page objects as Bootstrap pagination HTML
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 模板标签，用于将 Django 的 Page 对象渲染为兼容 Bootstrap 的分页 HTML。支持 Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x 版本，提供灵活的配置选项如页码范围、前后跳转链接等，适用于 Django 1.2+ 项目，现已归档不再维护。
repos.summary_en: This Django template tag renders Page objects into Bootstrap-compatible pagination HTML. It supports Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x, offers configurable options like page ranges and prev/next links, and is compatible with Django 1.2+. The project is now archived and no longer maintained.

repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

repos.description: Public docs & issues for flow.ci
repos.summary_zh: flow.ci 是一个开源的持续集成与部署平台，提供中英文双语文档和公开的问题追踪系统，旨在帮助开发者高效管理 CI/CD 流程，支持自动化构建、测试与部署。
repos.summary_en: flow.ci is an open-source continuous integration and deployment platform offering bilingual documentation (English and Chinese) and a public issue tracker to help developers streamline CI/CD workflows with automation.

repos.description: Django tools for building nonrel backends
repos.summary_zh: Djangotoolbox 是 Django 的非关系型数据库后端通用工具包，提供标准化接口支持在 NoSQL 数据库上运行 Django。它包含字段类型（如 ListField、DictField）、管理后台适配及权限处理支持，帮助开发者构建兼容 Django ORM 的非关系型数据层。
repos.summary_en: Djangotoolbox is a Django utility library providing a unified API for running Django on non-relational/NoSQL databases. It includes base classes for custom backends, specialized field types (e.g., ListField, DictField), and admin integration to support Django's admin interface without JOINs.

repos.description: Django storage for 七牛云存储
repos.summary_zh: Django Qiniu Storage 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的七牛云存储后端存储库，支持通过标准 Django Storage API 无缝集成七牛云存储服务，适用于托管静态资源和用户上传文件，支持 HTTPS 访问和灵活的配置方式。
repos.summary_en: Django Qiniu Storage is a Django backend storage library for Qiniu Cloud Storage, enabling seamless integration with Django's Storage API to manage static files and user uploads via Qiniu's CDN, supporting HTTPS access and flexible configuration via environment variables or settings.

repos.description: Improved memcached cache backend for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-newcache 是 Django 的增强型 memcached 缓存后端，支持 pylibmc、键哈希/版本化/风味化、无限超时及雪崩防护。通过自动处理键格式、版本控制和命名空间隔离，提升缓存安全性与多环境兼容性，默认行为已优化，支持自定义键生成函数。
repos.summary_en: django-newcache is an enhanced memcached backend for Django, offering pylibmc support, key hashing/versioning/flavoring, infinite timeouts, and thundering herd mitigation. It auto-hashes keys for safety, uses versioning for cache invalidation, and adds flavor prefixes for environment isolation—all with sensible defaults and optional custom key functions.

repos.description: Seamless integration of Algolia into your Django project.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 项目与 Algolia 搜索服务的无缝集成，支持自动索引同步、自定义索引命名、字段预处理等功能，适用于实现高性能实时搜索与自动补全。兼容 Python 3.8+ 和 Django 4.x/5.x，提供完整的搜索、地理搜索、标签及多索引支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository enables seamless integration of Algolia Search API into Django projects, offering features like automatic indexing, custom index naming, field preprocessing, and support for geo-search and tagging. Compatible with Python 3.8+ and Django 4.x/5.x, it simplifies building high-performance real-time search and autocomplete experiences.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级、专注国产生态的 AI 助手框架，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供统一的 Function Calling 能力。它原生集成 QQ、飞书、钉钉、企业微信等通讯平台适配器，内置 25 个工具（文件操作、浏览器自动化、定时任务等）、记忆系统、Skills 技能扩展机制，以及智能上下文压缩策略，适用于企业内部机器人和团队协作场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework focused on the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, and Qwen via unified OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible interfaces with native Function Calling. It integrates adapters for QQ, Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom, featuring 25 built-in tools (file ops, browser automation, cron jobs), memory system, Skills extension via SKILL.md, and intelligent context compression—ideal for enterprise bots and team collaboration.

repos.description: 同步豆瓣标记条目到 Notion/NeoDB
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库实现豆瓣标记数据（看过/听过/读过）通过RSS订阅同步至Notion数据库和NeoDB平台，支持自动抓取条目详情、评分、短评等信息，并通过GitHub Actions定时执行，适合个人知识管理。
repos.summary_en: This repository enables syncing Douban marked entries (watched/listened/read) to Notion databases and NeoDB via RSS, automatically fetching details like ratings and reviews using GitHub Actions for scheduled updates.

repos.description: ⚠️ 封号风控升级，请勿大量使用 / High ban risk, personal testing only 🚨 Use at your own risk.
repos.summary_zh: Kiro Stack 是一个将 Amazon Kiro（原 Q Developer）账号转换为 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 的代理系统，结合 kiro-go 的管理面板与 kiro-gateway 的稳定转发能力，支持多账号池、自动 Token 刷新和双端点容错，适用于 Cursor、Claude Code 等 IDE 集成。
repos.summary_en: Kiro Stack is a proxy system that converts Amazon Kiro (formerly Q Developer) accounts into OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It combines kiro-go's web admin panel with kiro-gateway's stable request handling, featuring multi-account pools, auto-token refresh, and dual-endpoint fallback for use in IDEs like Cursor and Claude Code.

repos.description: Change default search engine to OAIFree search(shared).
repos.summary_zh: OAIFree Search(Shared) 是一个 Chrome 浏览器插件，允许用户直接在地址栏使用 OAIFree 共享搜索功能。通过替换默认搜索引擎，实现快速访问 AI 驱动的搜索服务，适用于需要高效检索信息的用户场景。
repos.summary_en: OAIFree Search(Shared) is a Chrome extension enabling direct address bar searches via the OAIFree shared search engine. It replaces the default search provider for instant access to AI-powered search, ideal for users requiring fast information retrieval.

repos.description: 🧠 OpenClaw 融合记忆方案 — 三层 cron 自动记忆提取/蒸馏/巩固，零插件、零侵入、永不失忆
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Memory Fusion 是一个基于 OpenClaw 原生能力的融合记忆增强方案，通过三层 cron 机制（每小时/每天/每周）实现自动记忆提取、蒸馏与巩固。采用本地 session JSONL 为事实源，LLM 提炼高信噪比内容，Markdown 落盘确保可审计性。具备增量游标防重放、防套娃污染、Telegram 运维通知等特性，支持零插件侵入部署。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Memory Fusion is a memory enhancement solution built on OpenClaw's native capabilities, featuring three-tier cron automation (hourly/daily/weekly) for automatic memory extraction, distillation, and consolidation. It uses local session JSONL as the truth source, LLM-based refinement with high-signal input, and Markdown storage for auditability. Key features include incremental byte-offset cursors to prevent duplication, anti-recursion safeguards, and Telegram-based operational notifications, enabling zero-plugin deployment.

repos.description: 一个强大的 VS Code AI 编程助手
repos.summary_zh: LimCode 是一款强大的 VS Code AI 编程助手，支持多模态 AI 模型（Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic）及自定义格式，具备智能工具调用能力，可读写文件、执行命令、处理图像等。采用模块化架构，集成 MCP 协议扩展功能，支持对话存档与上下文总结，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: LimCode is a powerful VS Code AI programming assistant supporting multi-modal models (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and custom formats. It features intelligent tool-calling for file operations, command execution, image processing, and MCP protocol integration. With conversation archiving, context summarization, and modular architecture, it enhances developer productivity significantly.

repos.description: Get a better UI of V2EX.
repos.summary_zh: v2ex.k 是一款专为 V2EX 设计的界面增强浏览器插件，采用 Vue 重构，提供全新配色、左侧导航栏和快速阅读模式。支持主题切换、全键盘操作及 URL 动态更新，显著提升浏览效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: v2ex.k is a browser extension that enhances the V2EX website with a modern UI, featuring new themes, sidebar navigation, quick-read mode, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic URL updates for improved browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: Lingkuma - An open-source alternative to LingQ for learning any language on the web
repos.summary_zh: LingKuma 是一款跨平台的网页语言学习工具，支持 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 浏览器扩展及 iOS/Android 移动端。核心功能包括智能高亮翻译、AI 句子解析、生词笔记、TTS 语音朗读等，兼容 EPUB 阅读器和 PDF 文档，提供 WebDAV/Docker 数据同步，助力沉浸式语言学习。
repos.summary_en: LingKuma is a cross-platform web language learning tool with browser extensions (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) and mobile apps (iOS/Android). It features AI-powered translation, word highlighting, sentence analysis, TTS voice synthesis, and supports EPUB/PDF reading. Offers seamless sync via WebDAV or Docker for personalized, immersive language acquisition.

repos.description: A jquery and bootstrap basic tree view plugin, easily use.
repos.summary_zh: EasyTree 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Bootstrap 3 的轻量级树形视图插件，可将无序列表快速转换为支持选择、添加、编辑和删除操作的交互式树形结构，适用于需要动态层级数据管理的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: EasyTree is a lightweight jQuery and Bootstrap 3-based plugin that transforms unordered lists into interactive tree views with selectable, addable, editable, and deletable nodes, ideal for dynamic hierarchical data management in web applications.

repos.description: weui sketch by ZTfer
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供微信官方 WeUI 设计框架的 Sketch 源文件，包含完整 UI 组件库（按钮、单元格、弹窗、进度条等），尺寸与色彩严格遵循 WeUI 规范，支持 750*1334 设计稿尺寸，配套字体与@0.5x/@2x 效果图，助力设计师高效产出符合微信原生体验的界面。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides Sketch source files for WeUI, a UI framework by WeChat. It includes fully designed components (buttons, cells, dialogs, progress bars, etc.) with exact adherence to WeUI's design specs, supporting 750*1334 layout, bundled with @0.5x/@2x preview images and system fonts for rapid prototyping.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过 GitHub Actions 实现多邻国学习数据每日自动同步至 Notion，支持学习进度、词汇掌握情况等关键指标可视化展示。提供公众号教程与用户交流群，集成支付宝/微信捐赠通道，持续更新维护，是个人学习管理工具的高效自动化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This project automates daily syncing of Duolingo learning data to Notion via GitHub Actions, visualizing progress and vocabulary mastery. It offers WeChat tutorial, user groups for support, and donation options (Alipay/WeChat), with ongoing updates as part of a suite of productivity tools.

repos.description: 支持自定义配置API的Microsoft Word AI 写作助手加载项
repos.summary_zh: WriteBot 是一款集成于 Microsoft Word 的 AI 写作助手插件，支持文本润色、语法检查、中英翻译、内容生成与续写、文档摘要及格式排版优化。兼容 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 服务，提供侧边栏交互界面，所有操作在 Word 内完成，保障 API 密钥本地加密存储，确保数据安全。
repos.summary_en: WriteBot is an AI-powered writing assistant plugin for Microsoft Word, enabling real-time text polishing, grammar correction, translation, content generation, summarization, and document formatting. It supports multiple AI backends (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) via user-provided API keys, operates within Word's sidebar interface, and ensures secure local storage of credentials with no data uploads.

repos.description: 英语块学英语 - English chunk learning method, practicing English sentences through AI, to achieve rapid improvement of oral English.
repos.summary_zh: English Chunks 是一款基于 AI 的英语学习应用，从 YouTube 视频中提取地道英语表达（chunks），通过反复播放实现‘磨耳式’口语训练。项目完全由 Cursor AI 编写，支持一键 Vercel 部署，旨在帮助用户高效提升英语口语能力。
repos.summary_en: English Chunks is an AI-powered English learning app that extracts authentic language chunks from YouTube videos and uses repetitive playback (shadowing) to help users naturally acquire spoken English. Built entirely with Cursor AI, it supports one-click Vercel deployment for rapid access to immersive oral practice.

repos.description: 用于整合影视仓/tvbox本地包，提高访问速度
repos.summary_zh: My TVBox 是一个手动维护的影视仓/tvbox本地资源整合项目，通过自建服务器提供加速访问的JSON接口，显著提升影视资源加载速度，支持免费使用与持续更新，适用于家庭影院和在线观影场景。
repos.summary_en: My TVBox is a manually maintained project that integrates multiple local TVBox/影视仓 resource lines via a self-hosted server, delivering accelerated JSON API access to improve streaming performance. It offers free, regularly updated resources optimized for smooth viewing experiences.

repos.description: Generate RESTful json data for Hexo plugins.
repos.summary_zh: hexo-generator-restful 是一个 Hexo 插件，可将博客内容生成 RESTful 风格的 JSON 数据，支持分页、分类、标签和文章详情等 API 接口，便于构建 SPA 应用或前后端分离架构。
repos.summary_en: hexo-generator-restful is a Hexo plugin that generates RESTful JSON data from blog content, supporting pagination, categories, tags, and article details via API endpoints, ideal for building SPA applications or decoupled front-end systems.

repos.description: 一个将本地markdown在尽可能保持格式的情况下复制到公众号、知乎、飞书、X等平台的浏览器插件
repos.summary_zh: Markdown Paste Helper 是一款浏览器插件，可将本地 Markdown 内容一键粘贴至知乎、微信公众号、飞书、X Articles 等主流平台，自动转换为适配的富文本格式。支持预处理语法（如 GitHub alerts、任务列表）、自定义公众号主题色与代码高亮，并提供一键分发功能，实现‘一次编写，多端发布’的高效内容创作体验。
repos.summary_en: Markdown Paste Helper is a browser extension that enables one-click pasting of Markdown content into major platforms like Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, and X Articles, automatically converting it to platform-specific rich text formats. It supports preprocessing syntax (e.g., GitHub alerts, task lists), custom WeChat themes with code highlighting, and offers batch distribution across logged-in platforms for efficient multi-platform publishing.

repos.description: This is a Django helper for @defunkt's jquery-pjax.
repos.summary_zh: django-pjax 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于集成 jQuery-PJAX 实现页面局部异步加载，提升用户体验并保持浏览器历史记录。支持函数视图和类视图装饰器，自动替换模板为 `-pjax` 后缀版本，兼容 Python 2.7+/3.3+ 和 Django 1.3+。
repos.summary_en: django-pjax is a Django helper library that integrates jQuery-PJAX for partial page loading via AJAX, enhancing performance while maintaining browser navigation. It supports decorators for function and class-based views, auto-swapping templates to `-pjax` variants, compatible with Python 2.7+/3.3+ and Django 1.3+.

repos.description: Django database backend for MySQL that provides pooling ala SQLAlchemy.
repos.summary_zh: django-mysqlpool 是一个基于 SQLAlchemy 的 Django MySQL 数据库后端，提供连接池功能，通过 Monkey-patch 方式无缝集成，避免冻结 Django 核心代码。支持自定义连接池实现与参数配置，有效限制进程级连接数，提升高并发场景下的数据库资源利用率。
repos.summary_en: django-mysqlpool is a Django MySQL database backend leveraging SQLAlchemy for connection pooling. It uses monkey-patching to integrate seamlessly without freezing Django's core, supporting customizable pool implementations and arguments. It helps limit per-process connections, improving resource efficiency in high-concurrency environments.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: bootstrap3 validation
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap3-validation.js 是一个专为 Bootstrap 3 设计的 jQuery 表单验证插件，支持多种内置校验规则（如邮箱、URL、日期、数字等），支持自定义校验逻辑和异步验证，兼容 IE8，提供简洁的 HTML 属性配置方式，适用于水平表单和内联表单样式。
repos.summary_en: bootstrap3-validation.js is a jQuery plugin designed for Bootstrap 3 form validation, supporting built-in rules (e.g., email, URL, date, number), custom validation logic, asynchronous checks, IE8 compatibility, and clean HTML attribute-based configuration for horizontal and inline forms.

repos.description: 原版乔木 UI 学习的 DeepSeek Harness 迁移版：13561 设计参考、106 交互标本、审美测验与 Markdown 学习笔记

repos.description: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展，旨在提升用户阅读微信公众号文章的体验。通过自动生成文章的结构化目录，让您轻松了解文章结构、快速导航到感兴趣的部分，并在阅读长文时保持位置感知。
repos.summary_zh: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为优化电脑端阅读微信公众号长文体验而设计。核心功能包括自动生成结构化目录、图片放大预览、链接智能识别与跳转，以及阅读位置实时追踪，显著提升信息获取效率与视觉舒适度。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Reader Enhancer is a Chrome extension designed to improve the reading experience of WeChat Official Account articles on desktop. It features auto-generated structured table of contents, image zoom-in preview, URL recognition and clickable linking, and real-time reading position tracking, significantly enhancing content navigation and visual comfort.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastMCP 框架的 VSCode 扩展，将 VSCode 转换为 MCP 服务器，支持通过 HTTP Streaming 和 SSE 协议远程执行内部命令，提供工作区信息查询、异步执行、命令白名单等能力，兼容 Model Context Protocol 标准。
repos.summary_en: A VSCode extension using FastMCP framework to convert VSCode into an MCP server, enabling remote execution of internal commands via HTTP Streaming and SSE, with workspace info, async execution, command whitelisting, and full Model Context Protocol compatibility.

repos.description: AI assistant application based on Next.js, supporting Dialog Management and external Skill (script/tool/rule) integration. AI autonomously decides to invoke Skills, executes scripts in a Black box, installs dependencies, and generates files.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 的 AI 智能助手应用，支持对话管理与外部技能（脚本/工具/规则）集成。AI 自主决策调用技能，在沙箱环境中执行脚本、安装依赖并生成文件，具备对话记忆与多数据库支持能力。
repos.summary_en: An AI assistant built with Next.js featuring conversation management and external Skill (script/tool/rule) integration. The AI autonomously invokes Skills, executes scripts in a sandboxed environment, installs dependencies, and generates files, supporting both SQLite and PostgreSQL backends.

repos.description: AI assistant application based on Next.js, supporting Dialog Management and external Skill (script/tool/rule) integration. AI autonomously decides to invoke Skills, executes scripts in a Black box, installs dependencies, and generates files.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 的 AI 智能助手应用，支持对话管理与外部技能（脚本/工具/规则）集成。AI 自主决策调用技能，在沙箱环境中执行脚本、安装依赖并生成文件，提供 SQLite/PostgreSQL 双数据库支持和 Docker 部署能力。
repos.summary_en: An AI assistant built with Next.js featuring conversation management and external Skill integration. The AI autonomously invokes Skills, executing scripts in a sandboxed environment with dependency installation and file generation. Supports SQLite/PostgreSQL backends and Docker deployment.

repos.summary_zh: AnyRouter OpenCode Bridge 是一个专为 OpenCode 和 CherryStudio 设计的本地代理工具，通过 FastAPI + HTTP/2 中间层解决 AnyRouter API 的 WAF 拦截与 TLS 指纹检测问题，支持 Header 伪装、工具注入、流式透传及配置热重载，实现 Claude Code 客户端的无缝接入。
repos.summary_en: AnyRouter OpenCode Bridge is a local proxy tool designed for OpenCode and CherryStudio, resolving WAF blocking and TLS fingerprint issues when accessing AnyRouter API via an HTTP/2-enabled FastAPI middleware. It supports header spoofing, tool injection, SSE streaming, and hot-reload configuration for seamless integration with Claude Code clients.

repos.description: 🧠 Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI writing companion — smart context, undo, diff preview, multi-thread chat.
repos.summary_zh: Niki AI 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的 AI 增强插件，通过在侧边栏集成 Claude Code 实现智能写作辅助。核心功能包括原生对话界面、自动上下文引用、修改撤销和多话题管理，支持@文件引用和代码差异预览，显著提升 Markdown 笔记的编辑效率与交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Niki AI is an AI-enhanced plugin for Obsidian that integrates Claude Code into the sidebar for intelligent writing assistance. Key features include native chat UI, automatic context inclusion, undo functionality, and multi-topic management, with support for @file references and code diff previews to boost Markdown note editing efficiency.

repos.description: Qiniu(http://www.qiniu.com) is a cloud storage service, this package interages it with django framework.
repos.summary_zh: django-qiniu 是一个过时的 Django 插件，用于将七牛云存储服务集成到 Django 框架中。它通过自定义字段（如 QiniuFileField 和 QiniuImageField）简化文件上传与管理，支持自动生成文件 URL 和图像缩略图处理。需配合七牛 Python SDK 使用，现已不推荐使用，建议迁移至更现代的 django-qiniu-storage 方案。
repos.summary_en: django-qiniu is an outdated Django package that integrates Qiniu cloud storage with Django. It provides custom fields like QiniuFileField and QiniuImageField for seamless file uploads, URL generation, and image processing (e.g., thumbnails). Requires the Qiniu Python SDK and is no longer maintained; modern alternatives like django-qiniu-storage are recommended.

repos.description: :zap: :rocket:This is a upload plug-ins
repos.summary_zh: lUpload 是一个基于 jQuery 开发的轻量级文件上传插件，支持拖拽、粘贴、选择三种上传方式，具备实时进度显示、速度监控、多文件队列/并发上传控制，并可自定义文件类型缩略图与模板。适用于需要快速集成多模式上传功能的 Web 项目。
repos.summary_en: lUpload is a lightweight jQuery-based file upload plugin supporting drag-and-drop, paste, and file selection uploads. It features real-time progress tracking, upload speed monitoring, concurrent/sequential upload modes, custom thumbnails per file type, and flexible templating. Ideal for rapid integration of multi-mode uploads in web applications.

repos.description: Markdown  在线阅读器
repos.summary_zh: 在线 Markdown 阅读器支持代码高亮、目录自动生成、本地图片显示及导出 HTML，并集成 Todo 列表、MathJax 公式、时序图、Emoji 和 ECharts 图表等扩展语法，提供丰富的富文本阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: An online Markdown reader featuring code highlighting, auto-generated table of contents, local image support, HTML export, and rich extensions including Todo lists, MathJax, sequence diagrams, Emoji, and ECharts visualizations.

repos.summary_zh: django-pjaxr 是一个为 Django 项目提供 PJAX 支持的轻量级扩展，通过集成 jquery-pjaxr 实现无刷新页面加载，提升用户体验。它通过模板标签和上下文处理器简化配置，支持自定义模板，适用于需要局部刷新的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-pjaxr is a lightweight Django extension enabling PJAX support via jquery-pjaxr, allowing seamless partial page updates without full reloads. It simplifies integration with template tags and context processors, supporting customizable templates for enhanced user experience in Django web applications.

repos.description: claudeclaw
repos.summary_zh: MateCode 是一个通过 Telegram 远程控制 Claude Code 的桥接工具，支持长期记忆、会话管理、代码高亮等功能。采用纯 Python 标准库开发，基于长轮询实现低延迟通信，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: MateCode is a bridge tool that enables remote control of Claude Code via Telegram, featuring long-term memory, session management, and code highlighting. Built with pure Python standard libraries, it uses long polling for low-latency communication with local SQLite storage for privacy.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目是基于知识星球伴侣插件1.17版本的修复学习版，用于浏览器扩展开发。通过解压加载到开发者模式实现功能恢复，适用于知识星球内容下载场景，主要面向插件维护与逆向工程学习用途。
repos.summary_en: This project is a fixed learning version of the original ZSXQ companion plugin, based on version 1.17. It serves as a browser extension for downloading content from Knowledge Planet, primarily intended for educational and maintenance purposes.

repos.description: 微信支付的python接口
repos.summary_zh: weixin_pay 是一个为 Python 开发者提供的微信支付接口库，简化了微信支付 API 的调用流程。该库经过实际项目测试验证，支持核心支付功能，适合快速集成到电商、服务类应用中，提升支付模块开发效率。
repos.summary_en: weixin_pay is a Python library providing a simplified interface for WeChat Pay API. Developed for production use, it supports core payment functionalities and has been tested successfully. Ideal for integrating WeChat Pay into e-commerce or service applications efficiently.

repos.description: A collective list of free APIs for GPTs.
repos.summary_zh: GPTs-Public-API 是一个汇聚免费开放 API 的集合库，专为 GPTs 开发者设计，涵盖论文查询、Notion 集成、网页浏览、视频工具、自动化及 AI 辅助等场景，提供标准化接口支持智能体扩展与知识增强。
repos.summary_en: GPTs-Public-API is a curated collection of free APIs for GPTs developers, covering research paper retrieval, Notion integration, web browsing, video tools, automation, and AI utilities, enabling intelligent agent expansion and knowledge enhancement through standardized endpoints.

repos.description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
repos.summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
repos.summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.

repos.description: 油猴 chatgpt Prompt 脚本插件，在chatgpt聊天框导入Prompt 对话框
repos.summary_zh: 该油猴脚本为 ChatGPT 网页端提供中文 Prompt 训练对话框插件，支持一键导入预设角色提示词，提升交互效率。基于 GreasyFork 部署，集成 Docusaurus 搜索功能并优化 PC 端中文输入延迟问题。强调使用英文提示词以获得更稳定输出，建议添加 'respond in Chinese' 控制回复语言。
repos.summary_en: A Tampermonkey script that adds a Chinese Prompt training dialog to ChatGPT's web interface, enabling one-click import of role-based prompts for enhanced productivity. Hosted on GreasyFork with Docusaurus-powered search, it addresses PC-side input lag via debounce. Recommends English prompts for reliability and supports language control via 'respond in Chinese'.

repos.description: ⚡ Excel Plugin Framework | Excel插件框架 - C# .NET hot-reload template for VSTO add-ins. Features: WPF/WinForms UI, auto-update, COM safety, MVVM pattern. Perfect for Office automation & Excel/WPS plugins
repos.summary_zh: BasePlugin 是一个基于 DTI_Tool.AddIn 热插拔框架的 Excel 插件开发模板，专为 C#/.NET Framework 构建 VSTO 插件而设计。支持 WPF/WinForms UI、MVVM 模式、自动更新、COM 安全交互，适用于 Excel/WPS 自动化扩展开发。
repos.summary_en: BasePlugin is a comprehensive Excel add-in development template built on the DTI_Tool.AddIn hot-pluggable framework, enabling C#/.NET Framework VSTO plugin development with WPF/WinForms UI, MVVM pattern, auto-update, and COM-safe Excel interop for Office automation.

repos.description: 浏览器AI插件，一键把网页文章内容生成为思维导图，很方便。
repos.summary_zh: doc2mindmap 是一款浏览器AI插件，可将网页文章内容一键转换为思维导图，支持自定义大模型API接口。基于Chrome扩展开发，集成AI能力实现内容结构化呈现，适合知识整理与学习场景，代码开源便于学习浏览器插件与AI结合的开发模式。
repos.summary_en: doc2mindmap is a browser AI plugin that converts web page content into mind maps with one click. It supports custom LLM APIs and uses Chrome extension technology to integrate AI capabilities for content structuring, ideal for knowledge organization and learning. The open-source code serves as a practical example of combining browser plugins with AI models.

repos.description: DSH 插件：统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用——Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型/供应商/项目/来源/账号/日期拆分。A token usage, cost and provider-balance plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

repos.summary_zh: N-1 是一个基于 Flask 的多模型组合式聊天完成 API，支持文本与视觉多模态处理。通过并行调用多个大语言模型并使用摘要模型整合结果，提供全面准确的回答。具备流式输出、Bearer Token 认证、错误重试及实时状态反馈等特性，适用于 AI 开发者与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: N-1 is a Flask-based multi-model combination chat completion API supporting text and vision multimodal processing. It enables parallel querying of multiple LLMs with a summarization model to deliver comprehensive answers. Features include streaming output, Bearer token auth, retry mechanisms, timeout control, and real-time feedback, ideal for AI developers and researchers.

repos.description: 🚀 New API 智能价格同步工具 - 解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。智能推断上游基础价，一键同步模型价格。
repos.summary_zh: PriceSyncPro 是一款专为 New API 设计的浏览器插件，解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。通过智能推断上游基础价、自动适配 New API 和 One Hub 数据源，支持一键创建渠道/供货商/模型配置或批量更新价格，全程无需手动 SQL 操作，显著提升价格管理效率。
repos.summary_en: PriceSyncPro is a browser plugin designed for New API to resolve price sync failures caused by custom model prefixes. It intelligently infers upstream base prices, auto-adapts to New API and One Hub data sources, enabling one-click channel/supplier/model setup or bulk price updates without manual SQL operations, significantly streamlining price management.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.

repos.description: A reusable django application for handling Avatars.
repos.summary_zh: django-simple-avatar 是一个可复用的 Django 应用，用于处理用户头像。支持默认使用 Gravatar 作为头像，自动生缩略图并存储至默认文件存储后端，简化头像管理流程。
repos.summary_en: django-simple-avatar is a reusable Django app for handling user avatars. It supports default Gravatar fallback, automatically generates thumbnails, and stores them in the default file storage backend for efficient retrieval.

repos.description: django动态生成百度地图。
repos.summary_zh: djangoBaidusitemap 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于动态生成百度地图 XML 站点地图，支持 HTML5、WML 和 XHTML 多格式 URL 输出，兼容 Django 内置 sitemap 机制，适用于 SEO 优化与多终端内容分发。
repos.summary_en: djangoBaidusitemap is a Django extension that dynamically generates Baidu XML sitemaps, supporting multi-format URLs (HTML5, WML, XHTML), compatible with Django's built-in sitemap framework, ideal for SEO optimization and cross-platform content delivery.

repos.description: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序。它不仅仅是一个侧边栏插件，而是通过注入式的悬浮工具栏、强大的图像 AI 处理以及前沿的浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，将 AI 的触角伸向网页浏览的每一个交互细节。
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Nova 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini AI 的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理及浏览器控制协议 (MCP) 实现网页交互智能化。支持多驱动方案（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容），提供侧边栏对话、划词翻译总结、Mermaid 图表渲染、OCR 截图翻译及外部 MCP 工具集成等核心功能，赋予浏览器原生 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Nova is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini AI, enabling intelligent web interaction via floating toolbars, image AI processing, and Browser Control Protocol (MCP). It supports multiple backends (Web Client/Official API/OpenAI-compatible), offering features like sidebar chat, text translation/summary, Mermaid chart rendering, OCR screenshot translation, and external MCP tool integration for enhanced agentic capabilities.

repos.description: Obsidian 首页插件：快捷通道 · 收集箱 · 待办 · 项目 · 阅读笔记 · 复盘一体化，含配套 vault 文件夹结构。

repos.summary_zh: DjangoVerifyCode 是一个用于 Django 框架的验证码生成库，支持英文单词和数字两种验证码模式，具备自适应字体尺寸的图片生成与校验功能，适用于网站用户身份验证场景。
repos.summary_en: DjangoVerifyCode is a Django-based library for generating captcha images with English words or numbers, featuring adaptive font sizing and validation, ideal for user authentication in web applications.

repos.description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
repos.summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
repos.summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.
